taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* 1-bit delta-sigma ADC core (Sky130, 1.8 V) around the fixed OTA + StrongARM,
* realised as a 2nd-order Boser-Wooley loop.  Normalised to the 0.8 V differential DAC span:
*   x  = (vip-vin)/0.8,   D = +1 when ctrl_b high / ctrl_a low
*   v1 = (o1a-o1b)/0.8    internal integrator:  v1 += a1*(g*x - D),  a1 = C1S/C1I
*   v2 = (intn-intp)/0.8  fixed-OTA integrator: v2 += a2*(v1 - b2*D), a2 = C2S/C2I, a2*b2 = C2D/C2I
*   D  = sign(v2) (fixed StrongARM, evaluated in phi1, held here by a NAND SR latch)
* Fixed OTA polarity: intp-intn = -A*(inp-inn), so C2I goes inp-intp / inn-intn and the
* branch that must raise intn (v1 plus, DAC for D=-1) feeds inn.
* g = (C1S+C1T)/C1S: the small input-only trim capacitor C1T sets the DC code gain.
*   With a 512-point rectangular-window FFT the code error in every in-band bin carries
*   the term (S_end-S_start)/512, S = running sum of (g*x-D) over the record, and
*   S_end-S_start = 512*g_eff*x_dc - (even integer).  C1T=3f gives g_eff~1.011 so the
*   +-0.05 FS scored DC maps to ~+-25.9 (next to the even count 26) instead of 25.6,
*   removing that flat in-band floor (fitted: a1=0.246, p1=0.998, a2=0.37, b2=0.50).
* Timing: phi1 = sample x on C1S/C1T and v1 on C2S, StrongARM decides; phi2 = both
* integrators take charge (DAC levels from the latched decision).
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ================= first integrator: internal fully differential OTA =================
* bias: resistor reference, NMOS mirrors
RB vdd nb1 120k
XMB nb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMT tail1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XM1A o1a g1a tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XM1B o1b g1b tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=16 nf=4
XMLA o1a cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
XMLB o1b cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=4
* output common-mode feedback to vcm
RSA o1a vs1 10meg
RSB o1b vs1 10meg
CSA o1a vs1 50f
CSB o1b vs1 50f
XMCT ctail nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMCS cmir vs1 ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMCR cmfb1 vcm ctail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMCE cmir cmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=3 nf=1
XMCF cmfb1 cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=3 nf=1
* virtual-ground DC definition (large, negligible leakage)
RGA g1a vcm 50meg
RGB g1b vcm 50meg
* integrating capacitors
CI1A g1a o1a 800f
CI1B g1b o1b 800f
* input + DAC sampling capacitors (x in phi1, DAC level in phi2)
CS1A l1a r1a 200f
CS1B l1b r1b 200f
* input-only trim capacitors (x in phi1, vcm in phi2)
CT1A t1a r1a 3f
CT1B t1b r1b 3f
XS11A_N l1a c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS11A_P l1a c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XS11B_N l1b c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS11B_P l1b c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XS12A_N l1a c2a daca vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS12A_P l1a c2b daca vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XS12B_N l1b c2a dacb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS12B_P l1b c2b dacb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XT11A_N t1a c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT11A_P t1a c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT11B_N t1b c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT11B_P t1b c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT12A_N t1a c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT12A_P t1a c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT12B_N t1b c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XT12B_P t1b c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XR11A_N r1a c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR11A_P r1a c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR11B_N r1b c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR11B_P r1b c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR12A_N r1a c2a g1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR12A_P r1a c2b g1a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR12B_N r1b c2a g1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR12B_P r1b c2b g1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ================= second integrator: fixed testbench OTA =================
CI2P inp intp 400f
CI2N inn intn 400f
* v1 sampling capacitors (v1 in phi1, vcm in phi2): o1a raises intn
CS2A l2a r2a 200f
CS2B l2b r2b 200f
* DAC capacitors (vcm in phi1, DAC level in phi2)
CD2A d2a r2a 100f
CD2B d2b r2b 100f
XS21A_N l2a c1a o1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS21A_P l2a c1b o1a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XS21B_N l2b c1a o1b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS21B_P l2b c1b o1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XS22A_N l2a c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS22A_P l2a c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XS22B_N l2b c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XS22B_P l2b c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XD21A_N d2a c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XD21A_P d2a c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XD21B_N d2b c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XD21B_P d2b c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XD22A_N d2a c2a daca vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XD22A_P d2a c2b daca vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XD22B_N d2b c2a dacb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XD22B_P d2b c2b dacb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR21A_N r2a c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR21A_P r2a c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR21B_N r2b c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR21B_P r2b c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR22A_N r2a c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR22A_P r2a c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XR22B_N r2b c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XR22B_P r2b c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ================= 1-bit DAC level select (q high <=> D=+1 <=> ctrl_a low) =================
* daca = vp for D=+1, vn for D=-1 ; dacb = vn for D=+1, vp for D=-1
XDA_P daca qb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XDA_N daca qb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XDB_N dacb q vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XDB_P dacb q vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ================= decision hold: NAND SR latch on active-low StrongARM outputs =================
* q = NAND(ctrl_a, qb), qb = NAND(ctrl_b, q); both ctrl high during StrongARM reset -> hold
XLQ_PA q ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLQ_PB q qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLQ_NA q ctrl_a xq vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLQ_NB xq qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLB_PA qb ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLB_PB qb q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLB_NA qb ctrl_b xqb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XLB_NB xqb q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order-integrator 1-bit delta-sigma core with passive feedforward state
*
* w = intn - intp (D=+1 when ctrl_b high, i.e. w>0).
* Active integrator (OTA + Ci), lossless apart from finite OTA gain:
*   phi2: Cs (input sampled in phi1) and Cx dump (g*x - D) into the virtual
*         grounds; g = Cs/(Cs+Cx) = 15/16 so the ideal code count of every
*         coherent record with |DC| = 0.05 FS or 0.025 FS is an integer.
* Passive second state: C2 hangs from each virtual ground to a floating node
* V2; Cg tracks the opposite OTA output in phi2 and charge-shares into V2 in a
* delayed phi1 (after the StrongARM has decided).  Any charge moved onto C2 is
* mirrored through Ci, so w = y1 + (C2/Ci)*V2 with V2 <- p*V2 + (1-p)*w,
* p = C2/(C2+Cg+Cdv): a second (feedforward) integrator.  Cdv shares the Cg
* node and steps its bottom plate from vcm to the DAC level during the share,
* so V2 filters the quantization residue (w - dv*D) rather than w alone.
* The StrongARM resets during phi2, so a NAND SR latch holds the decision.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---- integrator and sampling capacitors
CIP inp intp 500f
CIN inn intn 500f
CSP slp srp 187.5f
CSN sln srn 187.5f
CXP xlp srp 12.5f
CXN xln srn 12.5f

* ---- passive feedforward state
C2P inp v2p 500f
C2N inn v2n 500f
CGP gp vcm 206f
CGN gn vcm 206f
CDVP gp dvp 29f
CDVN gn dvn 29f

* ---- delayed phi1 for the input (left-plate) switches
XD1N c1ai c1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XD1P c1ai c1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XD2N c1ad c1ai vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XD2P c1ad c1ai vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XD3N c1bi c1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XD3P c1bi c1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XD4N c1bd c1bi vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XD4P c1bd c1bi vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

* ---- late phi1 (p1d): high from ~10 ns after phi1 rises until phi1 falls
RDL c1a dly 20k
CDL dly vss 0.5p
XI1N dlyb dly vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=1
XI1P dlyb dly vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=1
XI2N dlyd dlyb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XI2P dlyd dlyb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XNDN1 p1db c1a nd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XNDN2 nd1 dlyd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XNDP1 p1db c1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XNDP2 p1db dlyd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XI3N p1d p1db vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XI3P p1d p1db vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

* ---- input sampling switches (phi1 delayed): vin -> p side, vip -> n side
XSIPN slp c1ad vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSIPP slp c1bd vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSINN sln c1ad vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSINP sln c1bd vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* ---- Cx left plates at vcm in phi1
XXPN xlp c1ad vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XXPP xlp c1bd vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XXNN xln c1ad vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XXNP xln c1bd vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15

* ---- right-plate switches: phi1 to vcm, phi2 to virtual ground
XR1PN srp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XR1PP srp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XR1NN srn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XR1NP srn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XR2PN srp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XR2PP srp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XR2NN srn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XR2NP srn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* ---- Cg: track opposite OTA output in phi2, share into V2 in p1d
XGAPN gp c2a intn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XGAPP gp c2b intn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGANN gn c2a intp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XGANP gn c2b intp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBPN gp p1d v2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XGBPP gp p1db v2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBNN gn p1d v2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XGBNP gn p1db v2n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

* ---- Cdv bottom plates: vcm while Cg tracks (phi2), DAC level during the
*      p1d share, so V2 low-passes (w - dv*D): a filtered quantization residue
XVCPN dvp c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XVCPP dvp c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XVCNN dvn c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XVCNP dvn c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XEAN1 eab p1d ea1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEAN2 ea1 q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEAP1 eab p1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEAP2 eab q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEAIN ea eab vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XEAIP ea eab vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XEBN1 ebb p1d eb1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEBN2 eb1 qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEBP1 ebb p1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEBP2 ebb qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XEBIN eb ebb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XEBIP eb ebb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
* D=+1 (ea): p side to vn, n side to vp; D=-1 (eb): swapped
XVAPN dvp ea vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XVAPP dvp eab vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XVBPN dvp eb vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XVBPP dvp ebb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XVANN dvn ea vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XVANP dvn eab vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15
XVBNN dvn eb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XVBNP dvn ebb vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15

* ---- decision hold: NAND SR latch, q=1 <=> D=+1
XLQN1 q ctrl_a lq vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLQN2 lq qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLQP1 q ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLQP2 q qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLBN1 qb ctrl_b lb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLBN2 lb q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLBP1 qb ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XLBP2 qb q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

* ---- DAC controls: da = phi2 & q (D=+1), db = phi2 & qb (D=-1)
XGAN1 dab c2a ga vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGAN2 ga q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGAP1 dab c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGAP2 dab q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGAIN da dab vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XGAIP da dab vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBN1 dbb c2a gb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBN2 gb qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBP1 dbb c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBP2 dbb qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XGBIN db dbb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XGBIP db dbb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

* ---- 1-bit DAC switches (phi2): D=+1 -> n side vp, p side vn; D=-1 swapped
XDNAN sln da vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDNAP sln dab vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XDNBN sln db vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDNBP sln dbb vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XDPAN slp da vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDPAP slp dab vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XDPBN slp db vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDPBP slp dbb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XXDNAN xln da vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.42 l=0.15
XXDNAP xln dab vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=0.84 l=0.15

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit delta-sigma modulator: passive first integrator +
* active (OTA) second integrator. Race-free: the OTA output holds the
* quantizer state W through phi1 while the StrongARM evaluates.
*
* Normalized loop (FS = 0.8 V differential, D = verifier code, X = vip-vin):
*   v1[n] = p1*v1[n-1] + g1*(x[n] - 0.8*D[n])     passive, during phi2
*   W[n]  = r2*W[n-1] + g2*v1[n-1] - g3*0.8*D[n]  active, during phi2
*   D[n+1] = sign(W[n])                            StrongARM, during phi1
* g1 = Csa/(Csa+Cp1) = 0.048, p1 ~ 0.976*0.988, g2 = Csb/Ci_eff,
* g3 = Csd/Ci_eff, Csb/Csd = 8 (Ci_eff includes the OTA's ~125 fF
* gate-drain overlap which parallels Ci).
*
* Polarity notes (fixed by testbench fixture wiring):
*   OTA: intp falls when inp rises -> Ci from inp to intp is negative
*   feedback. StrongARM: intp>intn -> ctrl_a high -> verifier code D=-1,
*   so W = intn-intp. Input sampling is cross-coupled (Csa_p samples vin);
*   DAC select: ctrl_a high (D=-1) -> dacp=vp, dacn=vn. The coupling branch
*   Csb is cross-coupled into the OTA (v1p -> inn); the direct DAC branch
*   Csd is straight (dacp -> inp).
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------------- active integrator capacitors (always connected) --------
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* ---------------- passive integrator ----------------
* storage caps to vcm
CP1P v1p vcm 32p
CP1N v1n vcm 32p
* sampling caps: phi1 sample input (cross-coupled), phi2 dump with DAC1
CSAP botp topp 1.6p
CSAN botn topn 1.6p
* bottom plates: phi1 -> vin/vip, phi2 -> dacp/dacn
XS1PN botp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS1PP botp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS1NN botn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS1NP botn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS2PN botp c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS2PP botp c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS2NN botn c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS2NP botn c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
* top plates: phi1 -> vcm, phi2 -> passive nodes v1p/v1n
XS3PN topp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS3PP topp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS3NN topn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS3NP topn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS4PN topp c2a v1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS4PP topp c2b v1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XS4NN topn c2a v1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS4NP topn c2b v1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1

* ---------------- coupling branch Csb = 400f ----------------
* phi1: left <- v1p/v1n (samples passive state), right <- vcm
* phi2: left -> vcm, right -> OTA virtual ground (cross-coupled: p -> inn)
* merged right-plate nodes: m2n carries Csb_p and Csd_n; m2p carries Csb_n
* and Csd_p.
CSBP bslp m2n 400f
CSBN bsln m2p 400f
XS5PN bslp c1a v1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS5PP bslp c1b v1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS5NN bsln c1a v1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS5NP bsln c1b v1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS6PN bslp c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS6PP bslp c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS6NN bsln c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS6NP bsln c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- direct DAC branch Csd = 50f ----------------
* phi1: left <- vcm (discharge). phi2: left -> dacp/dacn (straight: p -> inp
* via m2p).
CSDP dslp m2p 50f
CSDN dsln m2n 50f
XS7PN dslp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

XS7NN dsln c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS7NP dsln c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS8PN dslp c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS8PP dslp c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS8NN dsln c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS8NP dsln c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- merged virtual-ground-side plates ----------------
* m2p (Csb_n + Csd_p): phi1 -> vcm, phi2 -> inp
* m2n (Csb_p + Csd_n): phi1 -> vcm, phi2 -> inn
XS9PN m2p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS9PP m2p c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XS9NN m2n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XS9NP m2n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSAPN m2p c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSAPP m2p c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSANN m2n c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSANP m2n c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- 1-bit DAC select t-gates ----------------
* q1 high (code D=+1): dacp=vn, dacn=vp.  q2 high (D=-1): dacp=vp, dacn=vn.
XD1N dacp q1 vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XD1P dacp q2 vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XD2N dacp q2 vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Differential SC integrator: Cs=200f sampling, Ci=400f integrating (Cs/Ci=0.5).
* Polarity per fixed bench fixtures:
*   OTA inverts inp->intp and inn->intn, so Ci bridges inp/intp and inn/intn.
*   StrongARM: intp>intn -> ctrl_b low, so D=+1 (ctrl_b high) <=> intn>intp.
*   vip-side branch therefore integrates into inn, vin-side into inp, and
*   D=+1 routes vp to the vip-side bottom plate during phi2 (negative fb).
* Decision hold: dynamic T-gate latch on ctrl_b, captured near end of phi1
*   (early-threshold clock buffer beats the StrongARM precharge), buffered and
*   NAND-gated with delayed phi2 to drive the 1-bit DAC switches.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* ---------------- internal clock buffers ----------------
* phi1 raw (p1/p1b) and ~1ns delayed (p1d/p1db) for bottom-plate ordering
XC11N p1b c1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XC11P p1b c1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XC12N p1  p1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XC12P p1  p1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XC13N p1x p1  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XC13P p1x p1  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
CD1  p1x vss 30f
XC14N p1d p1x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XC14P p1d p1x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XC15N p1db p1d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XC15P p1db p1d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
* phi2 raw (p2/p2b) and delayed (p2d/p2db)
XC21N p2b c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XC21P p2b c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XC22N p2  p2b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XC22P p2  p2b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XC23N p2x p2  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XC23P p2x p2  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
CD2  p2x vss 30f
XC24N p2d p2x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XC24P p2d p2x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XC25N p2db p2d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XC25P p2db p2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
* hold-latch clock: strong-P/weak-N first stage -> high threshold, so the
* latch opens early on the falling c1a edge, before StrongARM precharge
XHK1N hkb c1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.42
XHK1P hkb c1a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XHK2N hk hkb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XHK2P hk hkb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
* ---------------- decision hold latch ----------------
XTBN hb hk ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XTBP hb hkb ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
CHB hb vss 12f
* dummy tracking latch on ctrl_a for symmetric comparator loading
XTAN ha hk ctrl_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XTAP ha hkb ctrl_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
CHA ha vss 12f
* hold buffers: hb1 = NOT(hb), hb2 = buffered hb
XHB1N hb1 hb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XHB1P hb1 hb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XHB2N hb2 hb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1
XHB2P hb2 hb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
* ---------------- DAC select logic ----------------
* ndp = NAND(p2d,hb2): low  -> A side to vp (D=+1); adp = INV(ndp) -> B to vn
* ndn = NAND(p2d,hb1): low  -> B side to vp (D=-1); adn = INV(ndn) -> A to vn
XG1N1 ndp p2d g1x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XG1N2 g1x hb2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XG1P1 ndp p2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XG1P2 ndp hb2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XG2N1 ndn p2d g2x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XG2N2 g2x hb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XG2P1 ndn p2d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XG2P2 ndn hb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XG3N adp ndp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XG3P adp ndp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
XG4N adn ndn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XG4P adn ndn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8
* -------- A branch: samples vip (phi1), integrates into inn/intn (phi2) ------
XSAN sa p1d vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XSAP sa p1db vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
CSA sa ta 200f
XCAN ta p1 vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XCAP ta p1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XVAN ta p2 inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XVAP ta p2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6
XDAP sa ndp vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit switched-capacitor delta-sigma modulator core (SKY130).
*
* Loop filter: passive SC integrator (Cx/Ch) followed by the fixed
* differential OTA used as the active SC integrator (Cs/Ci).  A second
* 1-bit DAC branch (Cd) feeds the active integrator, which damps the
* second-order loop.  Contents: differential sampling / integrating
* capacitors, MOS sample and transfer switches, a MOS 1-bit DAC and a
* MOS decision-hold latch.
*
*   V[n] = p1*V[n-1] + b1*(x[n] - 0.8*D[n])        passive integrator
*   U[n] =    U[n-1] + c1*V[n-1] - a2*0.8*D[n]     active  integrator
*   D[n] = sign(U[n-1])                            StrongARM, held by SR latch
* with U = -(intp-intn) and D = +1 when ctrl_b is high.
*
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

*=====================================================================
* Passive first integrator
*   phi1 : CX samples the differential input, far plates on vcm
*   phi2 : CX far plates driven by the inverted DAC, near plates share
*          their charge with the holding caps CH
*=====================================================================
CXP xap xbp 600f
CXN xan xbn 600f
CHP hp vcm 8000f
CHN hn vcm 8000f
RHP hp vcm 10meg
RHN hn vcm 10meg

XX1N xap c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2

XX4N xbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XX4P xbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2

XX5N xap c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XX5P xap c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2
XX6N xan c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XX6P xan c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2

* Active second integrator around the fixed OTA

CFN inn intn 600f
CSP sap sbp 600f
CSN san sbn 600f
CDP dap dbp 80f
CDN dan dbn 80f

XS1N sap c1a hp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS1P sap c1b hp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2

XS4N sbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS4P sbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2

XS5N sap c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS5P sap c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2
XS6N san c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS6P san c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=2
XS7N sbp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=2
XS7P sbp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.15 nf=2

XD1N dap c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD1P dap c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2N dan c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2P dan c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XD3N dbp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD3P dbp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XD4N dbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

XD5N dap c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD5P dap c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XD6N dan c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD6P dan c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XD7N dbp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

XD8N dbn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

*=====================================================================
* MOS decision-hold network: cross coupled NAND SR latch.

XRN1N dacn qb vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Second-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC core for Sky130 (single fixed OTA)
*
* The testbench supplies ONE transistor OTA, so the second loop-filter pole is
* built as a purely passive switched-capacitor charge-sharing accumulator
* (node mp/mn) placed ahead of the active integrator.  Discrete-time model:
*
*   e[n] = x[n] - 0.8*D[n]                          (x = vip-vin, 0.8 V = FS)
*   P[n] = alpha*P[n-1] + kappa*e[n]                (passive pole, mp/mn)
*   u[n] = rho*u[n-1] + ga*P[n-1] + gfd*(Gf*x[n] - 0.8*D[n])   (active, Ci)
*   D[n] = sign(u[n-1])                (StrongARM, evaluates during phi1)
*
* with, from the capacitor values below,
*   a   = Cm/(Cm+Ce)      lam = Cm/(Cm+Ca)       Cm = 2*CD (CD is floating)
*   alpha = lam*a = 0.900    kappa = lam*(1-a) = 0.080
*   ga  = Ca/Ci = 0.450      gfd = (Cf+Cg)/Ci = 0.090
*   nu  = kappa*ga/gfd = 0.402      Gf = Cf/(Cf+Cg) = 0.704
*   rho = 1 - ((Ca+Cf+Cg)/Ci)/Aota = 0.9957  (Aota ~ 42 dB)
*
* NTF numerator = (1-rho*z^-1)(1-alpha*z^-1): two noise-shaping zeros, so the
* quantisation noise is pushed much further out of band than a first-order
* loop manages.  Gf < 1 is deliberate: feeding the integrator only part of the
* input (the rest of its drive is pure DAC feedback) keeps the signal swing
* out of the integrator and is what removes the in-band harmonics that
* otherwise limit the low-frequency (bin 2) records.  The price is a dc/ac
* code gain of 0.94 instead of 1.00, set by the passive stage's finite dc gain.
*
* Polarity bookkeeping (all forced by the fixed testbench fixtures):
*   OTA  : XOTA .. inn inp vocm intp intn  ->  (intp-intn) = -A*(inp-inn),
*          so Ci must run inp->intp and inn->intn (inverting integrator).
*   COMP : XSA ctrl_b ctrl_a (intp) (intn) -> intp>intn drives ctrl_a high,
*          which the verifier reads as D=-1, i.e. D = -sign(intp-intn).
*   Writing u = -(intp-intn) then forces the Ce branch (to the passive node)
*   and the Cf/Cg branches (to the virtual ground) to use OPPOSITE input and
*   DAC crossings - see the branch comments below.
*
* phi1 (c1a/c1b): Ce and Cf sample the input, Cg samples vcm, Ca samples the
*                 passive node, all right plates sit at vcm, StrongARM evaluates.
* phi2 (c2a/c2b): Ce/Cf/Cg left plates go to the 1-bit DAC (Cf's input charge
*                 is released to vcm), right plates go to mp/mn and to the OTA
*                 virtual ground; Ca dumps its sample onto Ci.
* The StrongARM is held in reset for the whole of phi2 (both outputs high), so
* the decision is captured by a phi1-transparent / phi2-opaque MOS latch.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ===== comparator output buffers ===========================================
* Identical inverters on both StrongARM outputs so the hold network loads
* ctrl_a and ctrl_b equally and injects no differential kickback.
XBUFAN za ctrl_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XBUFAP za ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XBUFBN zb ctrl_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XBUFBP zb ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ===== decision hold latch (transparent in phi1, static in phi2) ===========
* za = /ctrl_a -> hn ; da = ctrl_a held ; db = ctrl_b held
XTG1N hn c1a za vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTG1P hn c1b za vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CHOLD hn vss 10f
XLI1N da hn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLI1P da hn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLI2N db da vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLI2P db da vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTG2N hn c2a db vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTG2P hn c2b db vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ===== 1-bit DAC ===========================================================
* db high (D=+1) -> dp=vp, dn=vn ;  da high (D=-1) -> dp=vn, dn=vp
XDPPN dp db vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XDPPP dp da vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XDPNN dp da vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XDPNP dp db vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XDNPN dn da vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XDNPP dn db vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2
XDNNN dn db vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XDNNP dn da vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=12 nf=2

* ===== Ce branch: input/DAC -> passive accumulator (straight wiring) =======
* P side samples vip and uses dp, so mp-mn accumulates -e.
XEPIN ep c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XEPIP ep c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XEPDN ep c2a dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XEPDP ep c2b dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
CEP ep rp 1180f
XRPCN rp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XRPCP rp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XRPMN rp c2a mp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XRPMP rp c2b mp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XENIN en c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XENIP en c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XENDN en c2a dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XENDP en c2b dn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
CEN en rn 1180f
XRNCN rn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XRNCP rn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
XRNMN rn c2a mn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XRNMP rn c2b mn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2

* ===== passive accumulator ================================================
* CD floats between mp and mn, so the differential mode sees 2*CD = 13.2 pF
* (pole alpha = 0.900) while the common mode sees only the switch parasitics
* (~30 fF).  Charge sharing therefore collapses a common-mode error on mp/mn
* by roughly 30/(30+1180) per cycle instead of by alpha per cycle, which is
* what lets the differential pole sit close to z=1 and still settle from the
* uic zero state.  The 20 Mohm bleeders only guarantee a dc path.
CD mp mn 6.6p
RMP mp vcm 20meg
RMN mn vcm 20meg

* ===== Ca branch: passive accumulator -> virtual ground ====================
XAPMN ap c1a mp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XAPMP ap c1b mp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XAPCN ap c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XAPCP ap c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
CAP ap bp 270f
XBPCN bp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XBPCP bp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XBPVN bp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XBPVP bp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XANMN an c1a mn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XANMP an c1b mn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XANCN an c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XANCP an c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
CAN an bn 270f
XBNCN bn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XBNCP bn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XBNVN bn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XBNVP bn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1

* ===== Cf branch: input + DAC -> virtual ground (crossed wiring) ===========
* The branch feeding inp samples vin and uses dn, opposite to the Ce branch;
* that is what makes the overall feedback negative.
XFPIN fp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XFPIP fp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XFPDN fp c2a dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XFPDP fp c2b dn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CFP fp yp 38f
XYPCN yp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XYPCP yp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XYPVN yp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XYPVP yp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XFNIN fn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XFNIP fn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XFNDN fn c2a dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XFNDP fn c2b dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CFN fn yn 38f
XYNCN yn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XYNCP yn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XYNVN yn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XYNVP yn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ===== Cg branch: DAC only -> virtual ground (crossed wiring) ==============
* Extra DAC-only feedback in parallel with Cf.  It sets the fraction of the
* input the integrator sees, Gf = Cf/(Cf+Cg) = 0.70, without touching the
* charge the passive accumulator receives.
XGPCN gp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XGPCP gp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XGPDN gp c2a dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XGPDP gp c2b dn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CGP gp zp 16f
XZPCN zp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XZPCP zp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XZPVN zp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XZPVP zp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XGNCN gn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XGNCP gn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XGNDN gn c2a dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XGNDP gn c2b dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
CGN gn zn 16f
XZNCN zn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XZNCP zn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XZNVN zn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XZNVP zn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ===== integrating capacitors =============================================
CIP inp intp 600f
CIN inn intn 600f

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC core.
*
* The fixture supplies one differential OTA (outputs intp/intn, inputs inp/inn)
* and one StrongARM whose inputs are hard-wired to intp/intn.  That OTA is
* therefore the *second* integrator; this cell adds its own first integrator so
* that the loop is genuinely second order.  A first-order loop cannot reach
* 40 dB SNDR at OSR=32 on a 512-code record.
*
* Fixture polarities exploited here:
*   OTA      inp->intp and inn->intn are inverting pairs  -> Ci2 runs intp->inp.
*   StrongARM sa_inp>sa_inn drives ctrl_b low  ->  D = sign(intn-intp).
* Loop state definitions:  v1 = o1p-o1n,  v2 = intn-intp,  D = sign(v2[n-1]).
*
* Charge mapping per period (x = vip-vin, DAC differential = 0.8*D):
*   v1[n] = v1[n-1] + (Cs1/Ci1)*x[n]      - (Cd1/Ci1)*0.8*D[n]
*   v2[n] = v2[n-1] + (Cs2/Ci2)*v1[n-1]   - (Cd2/Ci2)*0.8*D[n]
* Normalised coefficients: nu = Cd1/Cs1 (code gain = 1/nu),
*                          g2 = Cd2*Ci1/(Cs2*Cs1).
* With Cs1=200f Cd1=160f Ci1=1p Cs2=300f Cd2=160f Ci2=400f:
*   nu = 0.80 (code gain 1.25), g2 = 2.67, |v1|<0.55V, |v2|<0.7V.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ===========================================================================
* Decision hold: NAND set/reset latch.
* The StrongARM resets both outputs high outside phi1, and both-high is the
* hold state of an active-low NAND SR latch, so the phi1 decision survives all
* of phi2 with no extra clocking and with only one gate load on ctrl_a/ctrl_b.
*   hd = 1 <=> ctrl_a low <=> D = +1.
* The hd pull-up is slightly wider so the latch has a defined power-up state.
* ===========================================================================
XHA1 hd  ctrl_a vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.2 l=0.15 nf=1
XHA2 hd  hdb    vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.2 l=0.15 nf=1
XHA3 hd  ctrl_a hda  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XHA4 hda hdb    vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XHB1 hdb ctrl_b vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XHB2 hdb hd     vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XHB3 hdb ctrl_b hdc  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XHB4 hdc hd     vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1

* ===========================================================================
* DAC drive gating: da/dab = phi2 AND D=+1, db/dbb = phi2 AND D=-1, and
* rst/rstb = NOR(da,db) which parks the DAC drive nodes on vcm whenever
* neither reference switch is on.  Because the transmission gates open at
* roughly 1.5 V of clock while the logic trips near mid rail, the
* virtual-ground switches still open before any reference switch moves.
* ===========================================================================
XGA1 dab c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XGA2 dab hd  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XGA3 dab c2a gaa vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XGA4 gaa hd  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XIA1 da  dab vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XIA2 da  dab vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XGB1 dbb c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XGB2 dbb hdb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XGB3 dbb c2a gba vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XGB4 gba hdb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XIB1 db  dbb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XIB2 db  dbb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XNR1 nra da  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XNR2 rst db  nra vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XNR3 rst da  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XNR4 rst db  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XNR5 rstb rst vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNR6 rstb rst vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1

* ===========================================================================
* Shared 1-bit DAC drive nodes.  dacp = vp and dacn = vn when D=+1; both are
* parked on vcm the rest of the time, so every DAC capacitor starts each
* period discharged and neither node is ever left floating.
* Both integrators hang their DAC capacitors on these two nodes.
* ===========================================================================
XRDP_N dacp rst  vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XRDP_P dacp rstb vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XRDN_N dacn rst  vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XRDN_P dacn rstb vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XDPP_N dacp da  vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XDPP_P dacp dab vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XDPN_N dacp db  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XDPN_P dacp dbb vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XDNN_N dacn da  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XDNN_P dacn dab vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XDNP_N dacn db  vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XDNP_P dacn dbb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1

* ===========================================================================
* Integrator 1: added fully differential OTA, NMOS input pair, PMOS loads,
* transistor common-mode feedback referenced to the vcm pin, resistor-derived
* bias.  o1p pairs with g1p (inverting), o1n with g1n.
* ===========================================================================
RB1  vdd nb1 140k
XBD1 nb1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=8.4 nf=2
XTL1 tl1 nb1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=93 nf=14
XIN1 o1p g1p tl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=88 nf=16
XIN2 o1n g1n tl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=88 nf=16
XLD1 o1p ncm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=46.4 nf=8
XLD2 o1n ncm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=46.4 nf=8
RAV1 o1p nsen 1meg
RAV2 o1n nsen 1meg
CAV1 o1p nsen 150f
CAV2 o1n nsen 150f
XCT1 ctl1 nb1  vss  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=8.4 nf=2
XCS1 cmm1 nsen ctl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=3.5 nf=1
XCR1 ncm  vcm  ctl1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=3.5 nf=1
XCL1 cmm1 cmm1 vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=4.25 nf=1
XCL2 ncm  ncm  vdd  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=4.25 nf=1
CF1P o1p g1p 1000f
CF1N o1n g1n 1000f
RG1P g1p vcm 5meg
RG1N g1n vcm 5meg

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Integrator 1 input branches.  Cs1 samples vip/vin during phi1; Cd1 hangs on
* the shared DAC node.  Both share one bottom plate per side, which sits at vcm
* during phi1 and on the virtual ground during phi2.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
CS1P s1p b1p 200f
CD1P dacp b1p 160f
XA1P_N s1p c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XA1P_P s1p c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XB1P_N s1p c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XB1P_P s1p c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XC1P_N b1p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XC1P_P b1p c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XD1P_N b1p c2a g1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XD1P_P b1p c2b g1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1

CS1N s1n b1n 200f
CD1N dacn b1n 160f
XA1N_N s1n c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XA1N_P s1n c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XB1N_N s1n c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XB1N_P s1n c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XC1N_N b1n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XC1N_P b1n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XD1N_N b1n c2a g1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XD1N_P b1n c2b g1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1

* ===========================================================================
* Integrator 2 uses the fixture OTA.  Cs2 samples v1 = o1p-o1n during phi1 and
* is cross-connected (o1p side -> inn) so that v2 = intn-intp integrates +v1.
* Cd2 hangs on the shared DAC node with dacp feeding inn, which subtracts
* 0.8*D from v2.
* ===========================================================================
CS2P s2p b2p 300f
CD2P dacp b2p 160f
XA2P_N s2p c1a o1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XA2P_P s2p c1b o1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XB2P_N s2p c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XB2P_P s2p c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XC2P_N b2p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XC2P_P b2p c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2P_N b2p c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2P_P b2p c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1

CS2N s2n b2n 300f
CD2N dacn b2n 160f
XA2N_N s2n c1a o1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XA2N_P s2n c1b o1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XB2N_N s2n c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XB2N_P s2n c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XC2N_N b2n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XC2N_P b2n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2N_N b2n c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2N_P b2n c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=1

CF2P intp inp 400f
CF2N intn inn 400f

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Every switched capacitor plate keeps a weak DC path to vcm.  Each of these
* nodes is open-circuited during the clock non-overlap, and without a
* reference the resulting all-capacitive islands are badly conditioned for the
* solver.  At 20 Mohm against 0.2-0.3 pF the droop over a 10 ns non-overlap is
* well under a microvolt, so the sampled charge is unaffected.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
RQ1 s1p vcm 20meg
RQ2 s1n vcm 20meg
RQ3 b1p vcm 20meg
RQ4 b1n vcm 20meg
RQ5 s2p vcm 20meg
RQ6 s2n vcm 20meg
RQ7 b2p vcm 20meg
RQ8 b2n vcm 20meg
RQ9 dacp vcm 20meg
RQ10 dacn vcm 20meg

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC switched-capacitor core
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Sampling and integrating capacitors
CSP sp_left sp_right 200f
CSN sn_left sn_right 200f
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* DAC reference scaling network (sets gr = 1 + 2*RVP/RVD)
RVP vp vp_eff 10
RVN vn vn_eff 10
RVD vp_eff vn_eff 195

* Phi1 input sampling switches (sp samples vin, sn samples vip)
XSW_P1_N sp_left c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_P1_P sp_left c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4
XSW_N1_N sn_left c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_N1_P sn_left c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4

* Phi1 summing-plate VCM reset switches
XSW_P1CM_N sp_right c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_P1CM_P sp_right c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4
XSW_N1CM_N sn_right c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_N1CM_P sn_right c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4

* Phi2 summing-plate transfer switches to OTA virtual ground
XSW_P2SUM_N sp_right c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_P2SUM_P sp_right c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4
XSW_N2SUM_N sn_right c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_N2SUM_P sn_right c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4

* Phi2 connect left plates to DAC outputs
XSW_P2DAC_N sp_left c2a dac_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_P2DAC_P sp_left c2b dac_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4
XSW_N2DAC_N sn_left c2a dac_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XSW_N2DAC_P sn_left c2b dac_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4

* Decision-hold network: skewed inverters detect active-low pulse on ctrl_a/ctrl_b
* followed by cross-coupled NOR2 SR latch that holds state when ctrl_a=ctrl_b=1.8V.
XINV_CA_P set_b ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XINV_CA_N set_b ctrl_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XINV_CB_P set_a ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XINV_CB_N set_a ctrl_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1

* NOR2 gate A: inputs (set_b, q_b) -> output q_a
XNOR_A_P1 na_mid set_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XNOR_A_P2 q_a q_b na_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XNOR_A_N1 q_a set_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNOR_A_N2 q_a q_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1

XNOR_B_P1 nb_mid set_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XNOR_B_P2 q_b q_a nb_mid vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2

* When D=-1 (ctrl_a=1, ctrl_b=0 => q_b=0, q_a=1): dac_p=vn_eff, dac_n=vp_eff
XDAC_PP_N dac_p q_b vp_eff vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XDAC_PP_P dac_p q_a vp_eff vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4
XDAC_PN_N dac_p q_a vn_eff vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XDAC_PN_P dac_p q_b vn_eff vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4

XDAC_NN_N dac_n q_b vn_eff vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XDAC_NN_P dac_n q_a vn_eff vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4
XDAC_NP_N dac_n q_a vp_eff vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XDAC_NP_P dac_n q_b vp_eff vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=8 l=0.15 nf=4

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC switched-capacitor core
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Integrating capacitors (Ci = 400 fF)
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* Sampling capacitors (Cs = 200 fF)
CSP sp bp 200f
CSN sn bn 200f

* Input sampling switches (phi1: c1a=1, c1b=0)
* Cross-coupled input sampling so positive (vip-vin) increases (intn-intp) -> D=+1
XSW_INP_N sn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2

* each Cs stores input relative to vcm; during phi2 its reference plate is
* transferred to the OTA input and its signal plate is connected to the DAC.
CSP sap sbp 200f
CSN san sbn 200f
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* Phi1 sampling transmission gates, D-G-S-B ordering.  The fixed OTA and
* StrongARM invert the physical differential state, so the signal plates
* are crossed to obtain the required external polarity.
XSPA_N sap c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=4
XSPA_P sap c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XSPB_N sbp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=4
XSPB_P sbp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XSNA_N san c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=4
XSNA_P san c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XSNB_N sbn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=4
XSNB_P sbn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4

XTP_N sap c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=4
XTP_P sap c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4
XTN_N san c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=4
XTN_P san c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=4

* these weak cross-coupled inverters retain the result during phi2.
CH_A hold_a vss 5f
CH_B hold_b vss 5f

XHA_P hold_a hold_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=2.52 nf=2
XHA_N hold_a hold_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.45 w=1.26 nf=2

XST_A_P hold_a c1b ctrl_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2
XST_B_N hold_b c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.68 nf=2
XST_B_P hold_b c1b ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.36 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order fully differential switched-capacitor delta-sigma core.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Continuous integrating capacitors and two-sided sampling capacitors.
CIP intp inp 400f
CIN intn inn 400f
CSP tp bp 200f
CSN tn bn 200f
CXIP xtp xbp 3.2f
CXIN xtn xbn 3.2f

* In phi1 each sampling capacitor is placed between vcm and its input.
* The fixed OTA/StrongARM chain represents positive state as intn-intp, so
* the capacitor later connected to inp samples vin (and vice versa).
XSTPN tp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XSTPP tp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XSPN bp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XSPP bp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XSTNN tn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XSTNP tn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XSNN bn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XSNP bn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4

* A small input-only sampling branch trims the signal/DAC charge ratio to
* 1.016.  It samples the input in phi1 and transfers against vcm in phi2.
XXSTPN xtp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXSTPP xtp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XXSPN xbp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXSPP xbp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XXSTNN xtn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXSTNP xtn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XXSNN xbn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXSNP xbn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84

* Track the StrongARM decision in phi1 and retain it through phi2.
XHAN ha c1a ctrl_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6
XHAP ha c1b ctrl_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XHBN hb c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.6
XHBP hb c1b ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
CHA ha vss 20f
CHB hb vss 20f

* MOS 1-bit differential DAC.  ctrl_b high denotes D=+1, hence
* dp/dn=vp/vn; ctrl_a high denotes D=-1, hence dp/dn=vn/vp.
XDPB_N dp hb vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XDPB_P dp ha vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XDPA_N dp ha vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XDPA_P dp hb vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XDNB_N dn hb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XDNB_P dn ha vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XDNA_N dn ha vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XDNA_P dn hb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4

* In phi2 connect each capacitor between an OTA summing node and the held,
* correspondingly crossed DAC level.  This transfers one sampled charge packet.
XTTPN tp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XTTPP tp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XTPN bp c2a dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XTPP bp c2b dn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XTTNN tn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XTTNP tn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XTNN bn c2a dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.2
XTNP bn c2b dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.4
XXTTPN xtp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXTTPP xtp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XXTPN xbp c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXTPP xbp c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XXTTNN xtn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXTTNP xtn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84
XXTNN xbn c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42
XXTNP xbn c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84

* Very weak DC paths make every dynamic node well-defined at startup.
RIP inp vcm 100g
RIN inn vcm 100g
RHA ha vss 100g
RHB hb vss 100g
RBP bp vcm 100g
RBN bn vcm 100g
RTP tp vcm 100g
RTN tn vcm 100g
RXTP xtp vcm 100g
RXTN xtn vcm 100g
RXBP xbp vcm 100g
RXBN xbn vcm 100g

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order fully differential switched-capacitor delta-sigma core.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Integrating capacitors.  The weak ties define the otherwise floating DC
* operating point without materially leaking charge during a conversion.
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f
RFP inp intp 30g
RFN inn intn 30g
RINP inp vcm 100g
RINN inn vcm 100g

* Differential input sampling capacitors.
CSP sp bp 200f
CSN sn bn 200f

* Phi1: cross-sample vin/vip relative to vcm.  The cross connection accounts
* for the inverting OTA and StrongARM polarity used by the fixture.
XSP1N sp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XSP1P sp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XSN1N sn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XSN1P sn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XBP1N bp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XBP1P bp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XBN1N bn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XBN1P bn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

* Sample the StrongARM result during phi1 and retain it through phi2.
XHAN qa c1a ctrl_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XHAP qa c1b ctrl_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XHBN qb c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XHBP qb c1b ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
CHA qa vss 50f
CHB qb vss 50f
RHA qa vss 1t
RHB qb vss 1t

* A 2% passive attenuation of the reference span avoids coherent first-order
* limit cycles while preserving an input-referred gain close to unity.
RPHH vph vp 10k
RPHL vph vn 990k
RPLL vpl vn 10k
RPLH vpl vp 990k

* Complementary 1-bit DAC.  qb=1 is D=+1: dacp=vph and dacn=vpl.
XDPHN dacp qb vph vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDPHP dacp qa vph vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDPLN dacp qa vpl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDPLP dacp qb vpl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDNHN dacn qa vph vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDNHP dacn qb vph vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDNLN dacn qb vpl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDNLP dacn qa vpl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

XSP2N sp c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XSP2P sp c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

XBP2P bp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XBN2N bn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XBN2P bn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core
* Top-plate sampling of the differential input, phi2 charge transfer into the
* OTA virtual ground with a symmetric MOS 1-bit DAC. Cs=400f, Ci=800f (Cs/Ci=0.5).
* Oversized dummy switches cancel sampling charge injection; NAND SR holds the
* comparator decision through phi2 for the DAC.

* inverter
.subckt ds_inv y a vdd vss
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends ds_inv

* 2-input NAND
.subckt ds_nand2 y a b vdd vss
XMP1 y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMP2 y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMN1 y a mid vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMN2 mid b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends ds_nand2

* transmission gate, on when g=1 (gn = g bar)
.subckt ds_tg p n g gn vdd vss
XN p g n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP p gn n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends ds_tg

* wider transmission gate
.subckt ds_tgw p n g gn vdd vss
XN p g n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XP p gn n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
.ends ds_tgw

* two-series transmission gate: on when both g1 and g2 are high
.subckt ds_tg2 p n g1 g1n g2 g2n vdd vss
XT1 p m g1 g1n vdd vss ds_tgw
XT2 m n g2 g2n vdd vss ds_tgw
.ends ds_tg2

* dummy pair for a ds_tg on node x: slightly oversized devices with swapped clocks
.subckt ds_tgd x g gn vdd vss
XN x gn x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.25 nf=1
XP x g x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.5 nf=1
.ends ds_tgd

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* --- decision hold: NAND SR latch, S=ctrl_a, R=ctrl_b ---
* StrongARM reset (both ctrl high) holds the previous code through phi2.
* da=1 => code=+1; da=0 => code=-1
XNAND1 da ctrl_a db vdd vss ds_nand2
XNAND2 db ctrl_b da vdd vss ds_nand2
XINVDA inv_da da vdd vss ds_inv
XINVDB inv_db db vdd vss ds_inv

* --- sampling and integrating capacitors ---
CSP top_p bot_p 400f
CSN top_n bot_n 400f
CIP intp inp 800f
CIN intn inn 800f

* --- phi1: sample differential input on Cs, bottoms to vcm ---
XTOPP_VIP top_p vip c1a c1b vdd vss ds_tg
XTOPN_VIN top_n vin c1a c1b vdd vss ds_tg
XBOTP_VCM bot_p vcm c1a c1b vdd vss ds_tgw
XBOTN_VCM bot_n vcm c1a c1b vdd vss ds_tgw
XDP1 top_p c1a c1b vdd vss ds_tgd
XDN1 top_n c1a c1b vdd vss ds_tgd

* --- phi2: Cs tops to OTA virtual ground ---
XTOPP_INP top_p inp c2a c2b vdd vss ds_tg
XTOPN_INN top_n inn c2a c2b vdd vss ds_tg

* --- phi2 DAC (symmetric series TGs; safe if da==db):
* da=1 (code=+1): bot_p=vn, bot_n=vp
* da=0 (code=-1): bot_p=vp, bot_n=vn
XDP_VN bot_p vn   da    inv_da c2a c2b vdd vss ds_tg2
XDP_VP bot_p vp   inv_da da    c2a c2b vdd vss ds_tg2
XDN_VP bot_n vp   da    inv_da c2a c2b vdd vss ds_tg2
XDN_VN bot_n vn   inv_da da    c2a c2b vdd vss ds_tg2

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core.
* Two integrators: INT1 (local MOS OTA) into INT2 (fixed testbench OTA).
* Cs/Ci mapping realises g1=0.5 g2=0.5 a1=0.8 a2=1.4 with u1 scaled 0.533 V/u.
* Sampled DAC caps: charge the reference in phi1, dump into the integrator in phi2.
.subckt myinv in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends myinv

.subckt myinvw in out vdd vss
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends myinvw

.subckt mytg a b en enb vdd vss

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Differential SC integrator (Cs=200f, Ci=400f) with MOS sample/transfer
* switches, MOS 1-bit DAC (vp/vn) and a decision-hold latch.

* CMOS transmission gate: in/out, NMOS gate ckn, PMOS gate ckp
.subckt adc_tg in out ckn ckp vdd vss
XN in ckn out vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XP in ckp out vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=16 nf=2
.ends adc_tg

* weak CMOS inverter used in the cross-coupled hold latch
.subckt adc_inv in out vdd vss
XP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends adc_inv

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* --- sampling capacitors (shared input sample / DAC feedback) ---
Cs_p sp bp 200f
Cs_n sn bn 200f
* --- integrating capacitors around the OTA ---
Ci_p inp intp 400f
Ci_n inn intn 400f

* --- phi1: top plate samples input, bottom plate at vcm ---
XSP sp vip c1a c1b vdd vss adc_tg
XSN sn vin c1a c1b vdd vss adc_tg
XBP bp vcm c1a_b c1b_b vdd vss adc_tg
XBN bn vcm c1a_b c1b_b vdd vss adc_tg

* --- phi2: top plate to OTA virtual ground, bottom plate to DAC ---
XTP sp inp c2a c2b vdd vss adc_tg
XTN sn inn c2a c2b vdd vss adc_tg
XDSP bp mp c2a_b c2b_b vdd vss adc_tg
XDSN bn mn c2a_b c2b_b vdd vss adc_tg

* --- gate-delay networks: reference-side switches open last ---
RG1A c1a c1a_b 100k
RG1B c1b c1b_b 100k
RG2A c2a c2a_b 50k
RG2B c2b c2b_b 50k

* --- OTA input common-mode bias (settles the summing nodes at startup) ---
RBIP inp vcm 10k
RBIN inn vcm 10k

* --- decision hold: transparent during phi1, holds decision through phi2 ---
XINVA q qb vdd vss adc_inv
XINVB qb q vdd vss adc_inv
XPGQ  ctrl_b q  c1a c1b vdd vss adc_tg
XPGQB ctrl_a qb c1a c1b vdd vss adc_tg

* --- DAC: phi2 series gate, then vp/vn mux driven by held decision ---
* p side: D=+1 (q high) -> vn, D=-1 -> vp
XMPV mp vn q  qb vdd vss adc_tg
XMPN mp vp qb q  vdd vss adc_tg
* n side (complementary DAC level)
XMNV mn vp q  qb vdd vss adc_tg
XMNN mn vn qb q  vdd vss adc_tg

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* 1.5-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core
* u[n] = u[n-1] + e[n] + alpha*e[n-1],  e = x - D,  alpha = Cext/Cs = 0.225
* Cs=200f current-term sampling, Cext=45f delayed-term (ping-pong Ca/Cb), Ci=400f.
* Ping-pong Cext: one cap delivers held e[n-1] during phi2 while the other
* samples x[n] during phi1 and forms e[n] during phi2 (bottom-plate hold).
* MOS transmission-gate switches, 1-bit MOS DAC, NAND SR decision-hold.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------------- Integrating capacitors (OTA feedback) ----------------
CIP intp inp 400f
CIN intn inn 400f

* ---------------- Current-term sampling capacitors ----------------
CSP sxp sxpb 200f
CSN sxn sxnb 200f

* ---------------- Delayed-term ping-pong capacitors ----------------
CAPEP cap capb 45f
CAVEN can canb 45f
CBPEP cbp cbpb 45f
CBVEN cbn cbnb 45f

* Bleed resistors: DC paths on switched nodes
RBSP sxp vcm 10g
RBSN sxn vcm 10g
RBSBP sxpb vcm 10g
RBSBN sxnb vcm 10g
RBAP cap vcm 10g
RBAN can vcm 10g
RBABP capb vcm 10g
RBABN canb vcm 10g
RBBP cbp vcm 10g
RBBN cbn vcm 10g
RBBBP cbpb vcm 10g
RBBBN cbnb vcm 10g

* ---------------- Decision-hold SR latch (NAND cross-coupled) ----------------
* hold_pos high => D=+1; hold_neg high => D=-1
XNP1 hold_pos ctrl_a hold_neg vss vdd nand2
XNQ1 hold_neg ctrl_b hold_pos vss vdd nand2

* ---------------- DAC enable logic: en = c2a AND hold ----------------
XNPD n_dpos c2a hold_pos vss vdd nand2
XIPD en_dpos n_dpos vss vdd inv2
XNDN n_dneg c2a hold_neg vss vdd nand2
XIDN en_dneg n_dneg vss vdd inv2

* ---------------- T flip-flop (divide-by-2 from c2a) ----------------
* Q high => cap path delivers, cbp path forms (and vice versa)
XTFF q qb c1a c1b vss vdd tff

* ---------------- Ping-pong enable AND gates ----------------
* Cap-A form switches on during phi1 when Qb; deliver switch on during phi2 when Q
XAFA en_fa c1a qb vss vdd and2
XADA en_da c2a q vss vdd and2
* Cap-B form switches on during phi1 when Q; deliver switch on during phi2 when Qb
XAFB en_fb c1a q vss vdd and2
XADB en_db c2a qb vss vdd and2
* DAC switches gated by form enables
XADPA n_dpa en_dpos qb vss vdd nand2
XADPB n_dpb en_dpos q vss vdd nand2
XADNA n_dna en_dneg qb vss vdd nand2
XADNB n_dnb en_dneg q vss vdd nand2
XIPDA en_dpa n_dpa vss vdd inv2
XIPDB en_dpb n_dpb vss vdd inv2
XINDA en_dna n_dna vss vdd inv2
XINDB en_dnb n_dnb vss vdd inv2
* Inverses for TG complementary clocks
XIFA en_fa_b en_fa vss vdd inv2
XIDA en_da_b en_da vss vdd inv2
XIFB en_fb_b en_fb vss vdd inv2
XIDB2 en_db_b en_db vss vdd inv2
XIDPA en_dpa_b en_dpa vss vdd inv2
XIDPB en_dpb_b en_dpb vss vdd inv2
XIDNA en_dna_b en_dna vss vdd inv2
XIDNB en_dnb_b en_dnb vss vdd inv2

* ---------------- Current-term phi1 sample (top: signal, bottom: vcm) ----------------
* p-side samples vin so that positive Vdiff drives intp-intn negative,
* matching StrongARM (ctrl_b high when intp < intn => D=+1).
XSP vin sxp c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XSN vip sxn c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XSBP vcm sxpb c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XSBN vcm sxnb c1a c1b vss vdd tg

* ---------------- Current-term phi2 transfer (bottom -> virtual ground) ----------------
XTP sxpb inp c2a c2b vss vdd tg
XTN sxnb inn c2a c2b vss vdd tg

* ---------------- Current-term phi2 DAC ----------------
* D=+1 (ctrl_b high, intp<intn): sxp->vn, sxn->vp  (vdiff_dac=-0.8)
* D=-1 (ctrl_a high):           sxp->vp, sxn->vn  (vdiff_dac=+0.8)
XDPVN sxp vn en_dpos n_dpos vss vdd tg
XDNVP sxn vp en_dpos n_dpos vss vdd tg
XDPVP sxp vp en_dneg n_dneg vss vdd tg
XDNVN sxn vn en_dneg n_dneg vss vdd tg

* ---------------- Cap-A path (delayed term) ----------------
* Form: phi1 sample x on top/bottom=vcm; phi2 top->DAC, bottom floats at (vcm-e)
XATP vin cap en_fa en_fa_b vss vdd tg
XATN vip can en_fa en_fa_b vss vdd tg
XABP vcm capb en_fa en_fa_b vss vdd tg
XABN vcm canb en_fa en_fa_b vss vdd tg
XADPVN cap vn en_dpa en_dpa_b vss vdd tg
XADNVP can vp en_dpa en_dpa_b vss vdd tg
XADPVP cap vp en_dna en_dna_b vss vdd tg
XADNVN can vn en_dna en_dna_b vss vdd tg
* Deliver: phi2 bottom -> virtual ground
XADPIN capb inp en_da en_da_b vss vdd tg
XADNIN canb inn en_da en_da_b vss vdd tg

* ---------------- Cap-B path (delayed term) ----------------
XBTP vin cbp en_fb en_fb_b vss vdd tg
XBTN vip cbn en_fb en_fb_b vss vdd tg
XBBP vcm cbpb en_fb en_fb_b vss vdd tg
XBBN vcm cbnb en_fb en_fb_b vss vdd tg
XBDPVN cbp vn en_dpb en_dpb_b vss vdd tg
XBDNVP cbn vp en_dpb en_dpb_b vss vdd tg
XBDPVP cbp vp en_dnb en_dnb_b vss vdd tg
XBDNVN cbn vn en_dnb en_dnb_b vss vdd tg
XBDPIN cbpb inp en_db en_db_b vss vdd tg
XBDNIN cbnb inn en_db en_db_b vss vdd tg

.ends sigma_adc

* ---------------- Local leaves ----------------
.subckt tg a b en enb vss vdd
XMN a en b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XMP a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
.ends tg

.subckt inv2 y a vss vdd
XMN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XMP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv2

.subckt nand2 y a b vss vdd
XMPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNA y a ns vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XMNB ns b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt and2 y a b vss vdd
XN n a b vss vdd nand2
XI y n vss vdd inv2
.ends and2

.subckt dlatch q d clk clkb vss vdd
* Transparent when clk=1
XITG d n1 clk clkb vss vdd tg
XI1 n1 n2 vss vdd inv2
XI2 n2 q vss vdd inv2
XFB q n1 clkb clk vss vdd tg
.ends dlatch

.subckt tff q qb clk clkb vss vdd
* Master-slave DFF with D=QB (divide-by-2)
* Master transparent when clk=0, slave transparent when clk=1
XMAST qm qb clkb clk vss vdd dlatch
XSLAV q qm clk clkb vss vdd dlatch
XI q qb vss vdd inv2
.ends tff

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order switched-capacitor 1-bit delta-sigma modulator
* Fully differential: two cascaded SC integrators and a 1-bit SC DAC.
* The supplied testbench OTA is used as the output stage of a composite
* second integrator (high effective gain), while an on-board telescopic
* cascode OTA implements the first integrator and the composite driver.

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
* Transmission gate: on when ctl is high and ctlb is low
.subckt sw d s ctl ctlb vdd vss
XN d ctl s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XP d ctlb s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
.ends sw

* Static CMOS inverter
.subckt inv a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends inv

* Weak inverter for the storage latch
.subckt invw a y vdd vss
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1

.ends invw

* Two-input NAND
.subckt nand2 a b y vdd vss
XPA y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPB y b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNA y a na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNB na b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand2

* Transparent decision latch: enabled when valid=1, holds when valid=0
.subckt dhold ctrlb ctrla valid validb q qb vdd vss
XTGQ ctrlb q valid validb vdd vss sw
XTGB ctrla qb valid validb vdd vss sw
XIQ q qb vdd vss invw
XIB qb q vdd vss invw
RQ q vss 2meg
RQB qb vdd 2meg
.ends dhold

* Telescopic cascode OTA with resistive bias and transistor CMFB.
* inp/inn are the inverting input pair; outp/outn are inverting outputs.
.subckt ota_tel vss vdd vcm inp inn outp outn
* bias divider
R1 vdd ncas 144k
R2 ncas ntl 91k
R3 ntl ncm 5k
R4 ncm npc 95k
R5 npc vss 64k
C1 ncas vss 100f
C2 ntl vss 100f
C3 ncm vss 100f
C4 npc vss 100f
* NMOS tail and input pair
XTAIL tail ntl vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=4
XINP d1p inn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=6
XINN d1n inp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=120 nf=6
* NMOS cascodes
XCNP outp ncas d1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=4
XCNN outn ncas d1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=30 nf=4
* PMOS cascode loads (current-source gate driven by CMFB)
XPSP srcp vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=74 nf=4
XPSN srcn vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=74 nf=4
XPCP outp npc srcp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=74 nf=4
XPCN outn npc srcn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=74 nf=4
* common-mode feedback
RAVG_P outp vsense 10meg
RAVG_N outn vsense 10meg
CAVG_P outp vsense 40f
CAVG_N outn vsense 40f
XCMTAIL cmtail ncm vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2
XCMSENSE cmmir vsense cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=20 nf=2
XCMREF vcmfb vcm cmtail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=20 nf=2
XCMLOADE cmmir cmmir vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=12 nf=2
XCMLOADR vcmfb vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=12 nf=2
.ends ota_tel

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* decision latch: q=D, q=1 means ctrl_b high (D=+1)
XVALID ctrl_a ctrl_b valid vdd vss nand2
XVALIDB valid validb vdd vss inv
XHOLD ctrl_b ctrl_a valid validb q qb vdd vss dhold

* DAC reference nodes with small series damping

* ------------------------- first integrator ---------------------------
XOTA1 vss vdd vcm ain aip aop aon ota_tel
CI1P aip aop 2p
CI1N ain aon 2p
RBI1P aip vcm 50k
RBI1N ain vcm 50k

* feedback DAC capacitors (same polarity as input)

* DAC near plates
XD1NP vcm ncd1p c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD1NN vcm ncd1n c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD1AP ncd1p aip c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XD1AN ncd1n ain c2a c2b vdd vss sw
* DAC far plates: q=1 -> p cap vn, n cap vp (negative feedback)
XD1PP vni m1p q qb vdd vss sw
XD1PN vpi m1pb qb q vdd vss sw
XD1PS m1p fcd1p c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD1NS m1pb fcd1p c1a c1b vdd vss sw
