XD1PN2 vpi m1n q qb vdd vss sw
XD1PP2 vni m1nb qb q vdd vss sw
XD1PS2 m1n fcd1n c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD1NS2 m1nb fcd1n c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD1N2 fcd1n vcm c2a c2b vdd vss sw

* ------------------------- second integrator --------------------------
* Composite output stage: OTA2 drives the testbench OTA through the
* inp/inn pins (crossed, giving an inverting composite). intp/intn are
* the composite output.  Ci2/CC2 = 1, CD2/Ci2 = 0.5.
XOTA2 vss vdd vcm b2p b2n inp inn ota_tel
CI2P b2p intp 2p
CI2N b2n intn 2p
RBI2P b2p vcm 50k
RBI2N b2n vcm 50k
* Miller compensation around the composite (cross-connected)
CCP inp mcp 2.5p
RZP mcp intp 200
CCN inn mcn 2.5p
RZN mcn intn 200

* stage-2 coupling capacitors (a2 = 2p/2p)
CC2P ncc2p fcc2p 2p
CC2N ncc2n fcc2n 2p
* near plates
XC2NP vcm ncc2p c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XC2NN vcm ncc2n c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XC2AP ncc2p b2p c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XC2AN ncc2n b2n c2a c2b vdd vss sw
* far plates sample the first-integrator output during phi2
XC2FP aop fcc2p c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XC2FN aon fcc2n c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XC2VP fcc2p vcm c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XC2VN fcc2n vcm c1a c1b vdd vss sw

* stage-2 DAC capacitors (b = 1p/2p, polarity swapped)
CD2P ncd2p fcd2p 1p
CD2N ncd2n fcd2n 1p
* near plates
XD2NP vcm ncd2p c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD2NN vcm ncd2n c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD2AP ncd2p b2p c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XD2AN ncd2n b2n c2a c2b vdd vss sw
* DAC far plates: q=1 -> p cap vn, n cap vp
XD2PP vni m2p q qb vdd vss sw
XD2PN vpi m2n qb q vdd vss sw
XD2PS m2p fcd2p c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XD2NS m2n fcd2p c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XD2P1 fcd2p vcm c1a c1b vdd vss sw
XD2PN2 vpi m2np q qb vdd vss sw
XD2PP2 vni m2nn qb q vdd vss sw
XD2PS2 m2np fcd2n c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XD2NS2 m2nn fcd2n c2a c2b vdd vss sw
XD2N1 fcd2n vcm c1a c1b vdd vss sw

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core
* Input and DAC charge are delivered through separate capacitors so the
* effective full scale (code gain) can be set independently of the loop
* coefficients.  Integrating caps around the fixed OTA, CMOS switches,
* MOS 1-bit DAC and a MOS NAND decision-hold latch.
* The input is sampled late: a stretched sampling phase holds the input
* switches on past the phi1/phi2 boundary so the effective sampling
* instant is shifted by about 26 ns (implemented with the RC delay and
* the SR phase latch below).  This shapes the sampled sequence without
* changing the loop filter.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Two-phase generator with a stretched sampling phase.
*   dlyb falls = delayed rising edge of phi2 (RC + inverter).
*   rr = c2a & delayed(c2a): reset pulse set by the delayed phi2 rise
*        and released when phi2 falls.
*   SR latch: phs = NOR(rr, phsb), phsb = NOR(c1a, phs)
*   phs  is high from the phi1 rise until the delayed phi2 rise
*       (sampling phase, includes the non-overlap gap and early phi2).
*   phsb is the integration phase.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RDLY c2a dlyin 21k
CDLY dlyin vss 1p
XDLYN dlyb dlyin vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XDLYP dlyb dlyin vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* rr = NOR(c2b, dlyb)
XRN1N rr c2b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XRN2N rr dlyb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XRN1P rr c2b rnp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XRN2P rnp dlyb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

* SR latch: phs = NOR(rr, phsb)
XP1N phs rr vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XP2N phs phsb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XP1P phs rr p1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XP2P p1p phsb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* phsb = NOR(c1a, phs)
XE1N phsb c1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XE2N phsb phs vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XE1P phsb c1a p2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XE2P p2p phs vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

* Delayed integration phase and non-overlapping sampling phase.
*   a1   = ~phsb delayed
*   pint = phsb delayed (integration switches)
*   psamp = phs & ~pint, buffered (sampling switches)
* The sampling switches open before the integration switches close and
* the integration switches open before the sampling switches close, so
* vin and vcm are never shorted through a sampling capacitor.
XDA1N a1 phsb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XDA1P a1 phsb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XDB1N pint a1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XDB1P pint a1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
* nob = NOR(phsb, pint) = ~phs & ~pint
XNON1N nob phsb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNON2N nob pint vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNON1P nob phsb np1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNON2P np1 pint vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XPSN psampb nob vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XPSP psampb nob vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XPSBN psamp psampb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XPSBP psamp psampb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Integrating capacitors around the fixed OTA.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
Cia inp intp 400f
Cib inn intn 400f

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Side A sampling network.
*   DAC cap (ta-ba):    bottom vcm in the sampling phase, vn/vp from
*                       the held code during the integration phase
*   input cap (ta-bain):bottom vin in the sampling phase, vcm during
*                       the integration phase
* The top plate ta is at vcm during the sampling phase and at the OTA
* virtual ground inp during integration; the charge moved per cycle is
*   Cs_dac*(vcm - vdac) + Cs_in*(vin_sample - vcm).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
Csa ta ba 200f
Csain ta bain 268f

* DAC capacitor bottom plate (ba)
XBA1N ba psamp vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBA1P ba psampb vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XBA2N ba sd vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBA2P ba nd vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XBA3N ba sdb vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBA3P ba ndb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* Input capacitor bottom plate (bain)
XBI1N bain psamp vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBI1P bain psampb vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XBI2N bain pint vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBI2P bain a1 vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* Top plate ta: vcm in the sampling phase, inp during integration
XTA1N ta psamp vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XTA1P ta psampb vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XTA2N ta pint inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XTA2P ta a1 inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Side B sampling network (mirror image).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
Csb tb bb 200f
Csbin tb bbin 268f

* DAC capacitor bottom plate (bb)
XBB1N bb psamp vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBB1P bb psampb vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XBB2N bb sd vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBB2P bb nd vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XBB3N bb sdb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBB3P bb ndb vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* Input capacitor bottom plate (bbin)
XBI3N bbin psamp vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBI3P bbin psampb vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XBI4N bbin pint vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBI4P bbin a1 vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* Top plate tb: vcm in the sampling phase, inn during integration
XTB1N tb psamp vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XTB1P tb psampb vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XTB2N tb pint inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XTB2P tb a1 inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Decision-hold network: cross-coupled NAND latch.
* ctrl_a low sets q=1 (D=+1), ctrl_b low resets q=0 (D=-1).
* With ctrl_a=ctrl_b=1 (StrongARM reset) the latch holds its state,
* so the decision is available throughout phi2.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XQ1N q ctrl_a nq1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ2N nq1 qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ1P q ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ2P q qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

XQ3N qb ctrl_b nq2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ4N nq2 q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ3P qb ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ4P qb q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Integration-phase-gated DAC enables: sd = phsb & q, sdb = phsb & ~q
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XND1N nd pint nnd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XND2N nnd1 q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XND1P nd pint vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XND2P nd q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDN sd nd vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDP sd nd vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

XNE1N ndb pint nnd2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNE2N nnd2 qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XNE1P ndb pint vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XNE2P ndb qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDBN sdb ndb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDBP sdb ndb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

.ends sigma_adc

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Differential sampling/integrating capacitors, MOS switches, 1-bit DAC,
* and MOS decision-hold (D-latch) network.
*
* Loop: u[n] = rho*u[n-1] + 0.5*(x[n] - D[n-1]), D[n] = sign(u[n])
*   with u = intn - intp (so D=+1 when ctrl_b high), x = (vip-vin)/0.8.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* --- Sampling and integrating capacitors ---
Cs_p ap bp 240f
Cs_n an bn 240f
Ci_p intp inp 400f
Ci_n intn inn 400f

* --- phi1 sampling switches ---
* top plate to differential input (transmission gates)
Xspn ap c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xspp ap c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
Xsnn an c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xsnp an c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* bottom plate to common-mode (NMOS)
Xsbp bp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xsbn bn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- phi2 transfer switches (top plate to OTA virtual ground) ---
Xxpn ap c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xxpp ap c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
Xxnn an c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xxnp an c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* --- Decision-hold D-latch (transparent during phi1, holds during phi2) ---
* D = ctrl_b (high => D=+1). d = held D, db = held !D.
* TG1: ctrl_b <-> x  (on during phi1)
Xtg1n ctrl_b c1a x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xtg1p ctrl_b c1b x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* INV1: x -> db
Xinv1p db x vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xinv1n db x vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* INV2: db -> d
Xinv2p d db vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xinv2n d db vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* TG2: d <-> x  (on during phi1 low, holds)
Xtg2n d c1b x vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xtg2p d c1a x vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* hold storage capacitance
Cx x vss 10f

* --- 1-bit DAC (phi2 gated by c2a/c2b, steered by held decision d/db) ---
* D=+1 (d=1): bp -> vn, bn -> vp
* D=-1 (d=0): bp -> vp, bn -> vn
* bp -> vn : NMOS series (c2a, d)
Xdnn1 bp c2a dn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xdnn2 dn1 d  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* bp -> vp : PMOS series (c2b, d)
Xdpp1 bp c2b dp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
Xdpp2 dp1 d  vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* bn -> vp : PMOS series (c2b, db)
Xdpp3 bn c2b dp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
Xdpp4 dp2 db vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* bn -> vn : NMOS series (c2a, db)
Xdnn3 bn c2a dn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xdnn4 dn2 db vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Differential sampling caps Cs=200f each, integrating caps Ci=400f each (Cs/Ci=0.5)
* Fully-differential integrator + MOS 1-bit DAC + decision latch
* u[n] = rho*u[n-1] + 0.5*(x[n] - D[n-1]), D = sign(u), u = intn - intp
* Decision: D=+1 when ctrl_b high/ctrl_a low (latched on phi1, held through phi2)
* Rleak across Ci sets rho<1 to break 1-bit first-order idle tones (nominal SNDR)
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* --- Integrating capacitors (same-side feedback => negative feedback) ---
Ci1 intp inp 400f
Ci2 intn inn 400f
* --- Integrator leakage resistors set rho ~0.94 (break idle tones) ---
Rleak1 intp inp 3.3meg
Rleak2 intn inn 3.3meg

* --- Differential sampling capacitors ---
Cs1 t1 b1 200f
Cs2 t2 b2 200f

* --- Decision latch: capture ctrl_b during phi1, hold during phi2 ---
* transmission gate ctrl_b -> d, enabled on phi1 (c1a high, c1b low)
XTGLN ctrl_b c1a d vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTGLP ctrl_b c1b d vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* forward inverter d -> db (always on)
XINV1N db d vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XINV1P db d vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
* clocked feedback inverter db -> d, enabled on phi2 (c1a low, c1b high)
XFB1P cx db vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XFB2P d c1a cx vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XFB1N d db cy vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XFB2N cy c1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1

* --- + half: Cs1 samples vin on phi1, transfers to inp on phi2 ---
* b1 -> vin on phi1
XSIN1N b1 c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSIN1P b1 c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* t1 -> vcm on phi1
XSCM1N t1 c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSCM1P t1 c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* t1 -> inp on phi2
XSI1N t1 c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSI1P t1 c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* b1 -> b1p on phi2
XSP1N b1 c2a b1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP1P b1 c2b b1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* b1p -> vn when d high (D=+1)
XSD1N b1p d vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSD1P b1p db vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* b1p -> vp when db high (D=-1)
XSD2N b1p db vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSD2P b1p d vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- - half: Cs2 samples vip on phi1, transfers to inn on phi2 ---
* b2 -> vip on phi1
XSIN2N b2 c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSIN2P b2 c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* t2 -> vcm on phi1
XSCM2N t2 c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSCM2P t2 c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* t2 -> inn on phi2
XSI2N t2 c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSI2P t2 c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* b2 -> b2p on phi2
XSP2N b2 c2a b2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSP2P b2 c2b b2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* b2p -> vp when d high (D=+1)
XSD3N b2p d vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSD3P b2p db vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* b2p -> vn when db high (D=-1)
XSD4N b2p db vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSD4P b2p d vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core.
* phi1: Cs samples vip/vin vs vcm; StrongARM evaluates; input latch transparent.
* phi2: Cs transfers charge onto Ci with left plate at DAC level vp/vn
*        selected by the decision held by the on-chip static latch.
* MOS wrapper terminal order is drain, gate, source, bulk.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Decision-hold latch: transparent during phi1, static hold during phi2.
* hq follows ctrl_b (D=+1 when ctrl_b high); hqb is its complement.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XTGI_N hq    c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XTGI_P ctrl_b c1b hq    vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XL1_N hqb hq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XL1_P hqb hq vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XL2_N hqf hqb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XL2_P hqf hqb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XTGF_N hq  c2a hqf vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XTGF_P hqf c2b hq  vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* DAC select gates (static CMOS), gated by phi2 and by validity vld:
*   n1 = NAND3(c2a,hq,vld)  active-low vp select, inverted to a2
*   n2 = NAND3(c2a,hqb,vld) active-low vp select, inverted to a1
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* NAND3(c2a,hq,vld) -> n1 and NAND3(c2a,hqb,vld) -> n2: DAC inactive
* unless vld is high (live comparator decision was complementary).
XN1D n1 n1a c2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN1M n1a n1b hq vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN1S n1b vld vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN1PA n1 c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN1PB n1 hq  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN1PC n1 vld vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN2D n2 n2a c2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN2M n2a n2b hqb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN2S n2b vld vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN2PA n2 c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN2PB n2 hqb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3
XN2PC n2 vld vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3

* Validity detector: vm = NAND(ctrl_a,ctrl_b), low only while both outputs high.
XVMN vm vma ctrl_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XVMS vma ctrl_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XVMPA vm ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XVMPB vm ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
* Capture vm during phi1 onto vld; held dynamically through phi2.
XCAPN vld c1a vm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XCAPP vm c1b vld vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
CVLD vld vss 10f
XA1N a1 n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XA1P a1 n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XA2N a2 n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2
XA2P a2 n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Sampling Cs = 200 fF and integrating Ci = 400 fF (Cs/Ci = 0.5).
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* Weak output common-mode recovery aids (differentially symmetric).
ROP intp vcm 20k
RON intn vcm 20k

CSP lpp rpp 200f
CSN lpn rpn 200f
* Feedback pairing: vip-side integrates on inp/intn, vin-side on inn/intp,
* so u = intn-intp obeys D = sign(u) and DAC subtracts 0.8*D.
CIP inp intn 400f
CIN inn intp 400f

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* phi1 sampling switches: left plates to vip/vin, right plates to vcm.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XSIP_N lpp c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XSIP_P vip c1b lpp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XSIN_N lpn c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XSIN_P vin c1b lpn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRPP_N rpp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRPP_P vcm c1b rpp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRPN_N rpn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRPN_P vcm c1b rpn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* phi1 input common-mode reset: anchor OTA virtual grounds to vcm every phi1
* so the loop never inherits a saturated-state virtual-ground error.
XRINP_N inp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRINP_P vcm c1b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRINN_N inn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XRINN_P vcm c1b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* phi2 transfer switches: right plates to OTA virtual-ground inputs.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XTPP_N rpp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XTPP_P inp c2b rpp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XTPN_N rpn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XTPN_P inn c2b rpn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
* phi2 DAC switches at left plates.
* D=+1 (ctrl_b high, intn>intp): vip-side left plate -> vp, vin-side -> vn.
* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
XDPP lpp n1 vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XDPN lpp a1 vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XDNN lpn a2 vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4
XDNP lpn n2 vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC, switched-capacitor core.
*
* Phi1 (c1): Cs samples vip/vin (left plates to inputs, right plates to vcm);
*            the StrongARM evaluates the integrator output.
* Phi2 (c2): Cs right plates to OTA virtual grounds, left plates to the 1-bit
*            DAC, transferring Cs*(x - vDAC) onto Ci.
* The decision is captured in a phi1-transparent latch (qa/qb) and driven back
* onto ctrl_a/ctrl_b through phi2-enabled tri-state inverters, holding the
* code while the StrongARM is in reset.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---- Sampling / integrating capacitors ----
CSP spl  srpl 200f
CSN snl  srnl 200f
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* ---- Phi1 sampling switches (transmission gates: d g s b) ----
* Left plates sample CROSSED (spl<-vin, snl<-vip): together with the DAC
* mapping below this fixes the loop polarity for the StrongARM, whose code
* is D=-sign(intp-intn).
XSMPL_N  vin  c1a spl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSMPL_P  vin  c1b spl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSMNL_N  vip  c1a snl vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XSMNL_P  vip  c1b snl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* Right plates: srpl<-vcm, srnl<-vcm
XSRP1_N  srpl c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSRP1_P  srpl c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSRN1_N  srnl c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSRN1_P  srnl c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---- One-time power-up autozero ----
* With uic the OTA inputs start at 0 V; the 5meg bias resistors cannot move
* the ~2.9pF input-gate nodes in one phase, so the input pair/tail would be
* off through the first phi2 and the loop could latch at the rails.
* 'armed' starts at 0 and is slowly charged through the c1b PMOS only during
* phi1; after the first phi1 it rests near vdd, so every later c1 pulse is a
* no-op. The armed->armn inverter gates strong autozero switches for just
* the first ~20 ns, pulling inp/inn to vcm and bootstrapping the OTA bias.
CARM armed vss 1p
XCHG armed c1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=0.5 nf=1
XINV_N armn armed vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XINV_P armn armed vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XAZP inp armn vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2
XAZN inn armn vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10 nf=2

* ---- Phi2 transfer switches: right plates to virtual grounds ----
XSRP2_N  srpl c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSRP2_P  srpl c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSRN2_N  srnl c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSRN2_P  srnl c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---- 1-bit MOS DAC on the left plates (series-enabled only during phi2) ----
* D=+1 (ctrl_b high, ctrl_a low): spl->vn, snl->vp
* D=-1 (ctrl_a high):                spl->vp, snl->vn
* Code-selected device followed by a c2 enable device, so the DAC is fully
* isolated during phi1 and cannot fight the sampling switches.
* spl -> vp (PMOS chain, gated by ctrl_b low):
XDACP1 dpp1 ctrl_b spl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDACP2 vp   c2b   dpp1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* spl -> vn (NMOS chain):
XDACP3 spl ctrl_b dpn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDACP4 dpn1 c2a   vn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* snl -> vn (NMOS chain):
XDACN1 snl ctrl_a dpn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDACN2 dpn2 c2a   vn  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* snl -> vp (PMOS chain, gated by ctrl_a low):
XDACN3 dpp2 ctrl_a snl vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XDACN4 vp   c2b   dpp2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ---- Decision-hold network ----
* Master latch, transparent during phi1: qa=NOT ctrl_a, qb=NOT ctrl_b.
* Tri-state inverter ctrl_a -> qa, enabled c1 (series enable stack):
XTMA_PE mpa c1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTMA_PI qa  ctrl_a mpa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTMA_NI qa  ctrl_a mna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTMA_NE mna c1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Tri-state inverter ctrl_b -> qb, enabled c1:
XTMB_PE mpb c1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTMB_PI qb  ctrl_b mpb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTMB_NI qb  ctrl_b mnb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTMB_NE mnb c1a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Cross-coupled hold inverters qa<->qb (weaker than the tracking drivers):
XHOLDA_N qb qa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XHOLDA_P qb qa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XHOLDB_N qa qb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8  l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
XHOLDB_P qa qb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
* Phi2 output drivers (tri-state inverters): ctrl_a=NOT qa, ctrl_b=NOT qb.
* NMOS sized to beat the StrongARM reset PMOS (W=2) pulling both nodes up.
XTSA_PE spa c2b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSA_PI ctrl_a qa spa vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSA_NI ctrl_a qa sna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSA_NE sna c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSB_PE spb c2b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSB_PI ctrl_b qb spb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSB_NI ctrl_b qb snb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTSB_NE snb c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC, switched-capacitor core.
*
* Phase phi1 (c1a high): each Cs (200 fF) samples the differential input
* with its bottom plate at vcm.  The StrongARM evaluates during phi1 and
* its decision (ctrl_b state) is captured into the internal latch L.
* Phase phi2 (c2a high): Cs is transferred between OTA virtual ground and
* the code-selected DAC level (vp=1.3 / vn=0.5), charging Ci (400 fF).
*
* The StrongARM is reset (both outputs pulled high) during phi2.  During
* phi2 the latch holds one ctrl node low against the weak reset PMOS and
* drives the DAC selection.  The ctrl pulldowns release when c2a falls,
* so the reset PMOS precharges both comparator outputs before the next
* evaluation; the StrongARM never starts with one output held low.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---- P-side sampling capacitor plates: sp1p (input), sp2p (bottom) ----
* phi1: sp1p to vip
XSPP_N sp1p c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XSPP_P sp1p c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* phi1: sp2p to vcm
XSCMP_N sp2p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XSCMP_P sp2p c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* phi2: input plate sp1p to OTA virtual ground inp
XSIP_N sp1p c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XSIP_P sp1p c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* phi2: bottom plate sp2p to DAC node dpp
XTRP_N dpp c2a sp2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XTRP_P dpp c2b sp2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* code-selected DAC (gated by held latch L/lbar):
* D=+1 -> vn ; D=-1 -> vp
XDPP_N dpp L vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XDPP_P dpp lbar vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
XDPN_N dpp lbar vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XDPN_P dpp L vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15

* ---- N-side sampling capacitor plates: sn1n (input), sn2n (bottom) ----
* phi1: sn1n to vin
XSNN_N sn1n c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XSNN_P sn1n c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* phi1: sn2n to vcm
XSCMN_N sn2n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XSCMN_P sn2n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* phi2: input plate sn1n to OTA virtual ground inn
XSIN_N sn1n c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XSIN_P sn1n c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* phi2: bottom plate sn2n to DAC node dnn
XTRN_N dnn c2a sn2n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XTRN_P dnn c2b sn2n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
* code-selected DAC (gated by held latch L/lbar):
* D=+1 -> vp ; D=-1 -> vn
XDNN_N dnn L vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XDNN_P dnn lbar vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
XDNP_N dnn lbar vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XDNP_P dnn L vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15

* ---- Sampling and integrating capacitors ----
CSP sp1p sp2p 200f
CSN sn1n sn2n 200f
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* ---- Decision latch: captures ctrl_b during phi1, held on L ----
XLSH_N L c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15
XLSH_P L c1b ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
CL L vss 80f
* complement of held code
XINV_N lbar L vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XINV_P lbar L vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* ---- phi2 ctrl hold: latch drives one comparator output low ----
* D=+1 (L high): hold ctrl_a low ; D=-1 (lbar high): hold ctrl_b low
XHLA ctrl_a L hlda vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
XEA hlda c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XHLB ctrl_b lbar hldb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15
XEB hldb c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core.
*
* Single-OTA cascade: a passive switched-cap integrator forms the first
* stage (hold caps Ch on nodes pp/pn, charge refreshed each phi2 by the
* sampling caps Cs1, which sample the crossed differential inputs in phi1
* and the 1-bit DAC levels in phi2). The fixed OTA forms the active second
* integrator: Ci are its feedback caps, Cd is a crossed delta tap (stores
* the phi1 passive-node level, then bridges passive node to virtual ground
* in phi2) and Ca is a small same-side absolute tap. The OTA integrates
* only during phi2, so intp/intn are settled and stable when the StrongARM
* evaluates during phi1. The StrongARM resets during phi2, so a phi1-
* transparent / phi2-latching TG latch holds the decision for the DAC.
*
* Discrete-time behaviour is second-order noise shaping
*   u[n] = rho*u[n-1] + (Cd/Ci)*(p[n]-p[n-1]) + (Ca/Ci)*p[n-1]
* with the passive first stage p[n] = a*p[n-1] + b*(-x[n] + 0.8*D[n]).
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---- passive first-integrator hold caps and DC bleed ----
CHP pp vcm 7p
CHN pn vcm 7p
RBLP pp vcm 5meg
RBLN pn vcm 5meg

* ---- active integrating caps (OTA feedback) ----
CIP inp intp 250f
CIN inn intn 250f

* ---- first-stage sampling caps Cs1 (200f) ----
CS1P s1p s1pb 300f
CS1N s1n s1nb 300f
* phi1: top plate to crossed inputs, bottom plate to vcm
XSI1P vin s1p c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XSB1P s1pb vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XSI1N vip s1n c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XSB1N s1nb vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
* phi2: bottom plate to passive hold node, top plate to DAC level
XF1P s1pb pp c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
XF1N s1nb pn c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big

* ---- second-stage delta tap caps Cd (200f) ----
* plate B on the same-side passive node; plate A switched vcm (phi1) ->
* the opposite virtual ground (phi2). The side cross plus the OTA
* inversion makes the output integrate -integral(p), closing negative
* feedback through the inverting StrongARM.
CDP cdp pp 550f
CDN cdn pn 550f
XRDP1 cdp vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XRDP2 cdp inp c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
XRDN1 cdn vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XRDN2 cdn inn c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
* ---- second-stage absolute tap caps Ca (25f), likewise crossed ----
CAP cap ca 120f
CAN can cb 120f
* plate A: vcm in phi1 -> opposite virtual ground in phi2
XRAP1 cap vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XRAP2 cap inn c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
XRAN1 can vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XRAN2 can inp c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
* plate B: same-side passive node in phi1 -> vcm in phi2
XRBP1 ca pp c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XRBP2 ca vcm c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
XRBN1 cb pn c1a c1b vdd vss tgate_big
XRBN2 cb vcm c2a c2b vdd vss tgate_big
* ---- decision-hold latch: transparent during phi1, holds during phi2 ----
XTGLM ctrl_a q c1a c1b vdd vss tgate
XLI1 q qn vdd vss inv
XLI2 qn qf vdd vss inv
XTGLF qf q c2a c2b vdd vss tgate
XLI3 q lt1 vdd vss inv
XLI4 lt1 ha vdd vss inv
XLI5 qn lt2 vdd vss inv
XLI6 lt2 hb vdd vss inv
* ha = held ctrl_a (D=-1), hb = held ctrl_b (D=+1)

* ---- phi2 gating of the held decision for the DAC switches ----
XNDA c2a ha nanda vdd vss nand2
XINA nanda anda vdd vss inv
XNDB c2a hb nandb vdd vss nand2
XINB nandb andb vdd vss inv

* ---- 1-bit DAC level switches for the first-stage sampling caps ----
* Crossed decode closes negative feedback with the inverting StrongARM:
* D=+1 (hb) pulls the p-side sampling cap to vn(0.5) and the n-side to
* vp(1.3); D=-1 (ha) does the reverse.
XDPP s1p vn andb nandb vdd vss tgate
XDPN s1p vp anda nanda vdd vss tgate
XDNP s1n vp andb nandb vdd vss tgate
XDNN s1n vn anda nanda vdd vss tgate

.ends sigma_adc

* ---- helper subcircuits ----
.subckt tgate a b gn gp vdd vss
XTGN b gn a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XTGP b gp a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
.ends tgate

.subckt tgate_big a b gn gp vdd vss
XTGN b gn a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3.0 nf=3
XTGP b gp a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6.0 nf=3
.ends tgate_big

* Feedback keepers for the hold latch (small inverters).
.subckt tgate_hold a b gn gp vdd vss
XTGN b gn a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=0.5 nf=1
XTGP b gp a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends tgate_hold

.subckt inv in out vdd vss
XIN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XIP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
.ends inv

.subckt nand2 a b out vdd vss
XN1 out a na vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XN2 na b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=2
XP1 out a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XP2 out b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
.ends nand2

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC, switched-capacitor core.
* phi1 (c1 high, ~0-50ns): Cs samples input (signal plate to vip/vin, OTA-side
*   plate to vcm). Ci stays across the OTA in both phases, so the OTA holds
*   virtual ground and its differential output state through phi1; the
*   StrongARM evaluates intp/intn and drives ctrl_a/ctrl_b.
* phi2 (c2 high, ~50-100ns): Cs OTA-side plate flips to the OTA input and the
*   signal plate flips to the DAC level selected by the latched decision; the
*   resulting charge transfer integrates onto Ci.
* Sampling caps cross between phases (p-side integrates on inn/intn, n-side
*   on inp/intp) so that positive input raises intn above intp (D=+1) and the
*   DAC feedback drives intp-intn back up (negative feedback). Loop update:
*   intp-intn change = +(Cs/Ci)*(0.8*D - x), Cs/Ci=0.5; D=+1 (ctrl_b high,
*   ctrl_a low) when intn rises above intp.
* Switches use low-Vth devices (mid-rail ~0.9V signals). Device terminal
* order (PDK wrappers): drain gate source bulk.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
*
* ---------------- decision-hold (active-low SR NAND latch) ------------------
* StrongARM outputs are precharged high in reset/phi2 and go complementary
* only during phi1 evaluation. Cross-coupled NANDs hold the decision: both
* inputs high = hold; a low pulse on ctrl_a sets lq (D=+1), on ctrl_b sets
* lqb (D=-1). Comparator reset (both high) cannot erase the captured state.
*   lq  = NAND(ctrl_a, lqb) -> high when ctrl_a was low  (D=+1)
*   lqb = NAND(ctrl_b, lq)  -> high when ctrl_b was low  (D=-1)
XLAT1P lq  ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XLAT2P lq  lqb    vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XLAT1N lq  ctrl_a la1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLAT2N la1 lqb    vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLAT3P lqb ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XLAT4P lqb lq     vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XLAT3N lqb ctrl_b la3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XLAT4N la3 lq     vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
*
* decision gating NANDs (output LOW only in phi2 when that level is selected):
* dap_g = ~(c2a & lq)  : D=+1 select (p-plate->vp, n-plate->vn)
* dan_g = ~(c2a & lqb) : D=-1 select (p-plate->vn, n-plate->vp)
XND1P dap_g c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XND2P dap_g lq  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XND1N dap_g c2a nd1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XND2N nd1   lq  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XND3P dan_g c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XND4P dan_g lqb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XND3N dan_g c2a nd3 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XND4N nd3   lqb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
* inverted (AND) levels for the NMOS DAC-switch gates (HIGH when selected)
XINVP1 dap_gn dap_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XINVN1 dap_gn dap_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
XINVP2 dan_gn dan_g vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=6 nf=3
XINVN2 dan_gn dan_g vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=3 nf=1
*
* ---------------- capacitors ----------------
* sampling caps: signal plate (vip_s/vin_s) to OTA-side plate (vx_p/vx_n)
CSP vx_p vip_s 200f
CSN vx_n vin_s 200f
* integrating caps stay across the OTA in both phases
CIP inp  intp  400f
CIN inn  intn  400f
* weak DC path defining the virtual-ground common mode at startup (OTA inputs
* are MOS gates). Large enough that the closed-loop integrator leak time
* constant R*Ci*(1+A) is many signal periods; small enough to bootstrap the
* inputs to vcm within the first ~20 cycles.
RVIP inp vcm 10meg
RVIN inn vcm 10meg
*
* ---- phi1 sampling switches: signal plate to input (transmission gates) ----
* PMOS gate=c1b (low=on), NMOS gate=c1a (high=on); order: d g s b
XSPP vip_s c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XSPN vip_s c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XSNP vin_s c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XSNN vin_s c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
*
* -- OTA-side Cs plate: phi1 to vcm, phi2 to the OPPOSITE OTA input (cross) --
XCP1P vx_p c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XCP1N vx_p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XCP2P vx_p c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XCP2N vx_p c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XCN1P vx_n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XCN1N vx_n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XCN2P vx_n c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XCN2N vx_n c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
*
* ---------------- DAC selection switches (transmission gates, gated) ---------
* PMOS gate = NAND output (low=selected in phi2); NMOS gate = AND output
* (high=selected). Fully off in phi1 and when deselected.
* p-side cap plate (vip_s): D=+1 -> vp (1.3V), D=-1 -> vn (0.5V)
XDAP_P vip_s dap_g  vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XDAP_N vip_s dap_gn vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XDAN_P vip_s dan_g  vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XDAN_N vip_s dan_gn vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
* n-side cap plate (vin_s): D=+1 -> vn (0.5V), D=-1 -> vp (1.3V)
XDBN_P vin_s dap_g  vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XDBN_N vin_s dap_gn vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
XDBP_P vin_s dan_g  vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=24 nf=8
XDBP_N vin_s dan_gn vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=12 nf=4
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order / second-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC switched-capacitor core.
* Top-level interface preserved exactly as specified.
* Fixture: OTA (inp/inn inputs, intp/intn outputs) + StrongARM (ctrl_a/ctrl_b).
* DUT provides: sampling caps, integrating caps, sample/transfer switches,
* 1-bit DAC switch network, and decision-hold latch.

* --- transmission gate: n1 n2 , nm-gate=gn, pm-gate=gp ---
.subckt tg n1 n2 gn gp vss vdd
XN n1 gn n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XP n1 gp n2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends tg

* --- inverter ---
.subckt inv a y vss vdd
XN y a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.2 l=0.15 nf=1
XP y a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2.4 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* === Integrating capacitors (Ci = 400 fF) ===
CIP intp inp 400f
CIN intn inn 400f

* === virtual-ground DC reference (establish OTA op point under uic;
*     ~0V across in steady state so differential leak is negligible) ===
RBP inp vcm 250k
RBN inn vcm 250k

* === Sampling capacitors (Cs = 200 fF) ===
CSP tp bp 200f
CSN tn bn 200f

* === phi1 sampling phase: top plate -> vcm, bottom plate -> input ===
* (input swapped vs DAC side to compensate comparator inversion -> non-inverting)
XS1 tp vcm c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XS2 tn vcm c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XS3 bp vin c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XS4 bn vip c1a c1b vss vdd tg

* === phi2 transfer phase: top plate -> virtual ground, bottom plate -> ref node ===
XS5 tp inp c2a c2b vss vdd tg
XS6 tn inn c2a c2b vss vdd tg
XS7 bp xp c2a c2b vss vdd tg
XS8 bn xn c2a c2b vss vdd tg

* === 1-bit DAC ref selection (negative-feedback polarity) ===
* du = (Cs/Ci)*(x - Vdac_diff).  Need: u>0 -> reduce u -> Vdac_diff>0 (subtract).
* u>0 -> D=-1 -> ctrl_a high -> da high -> Csp->vp, Csn->vn => Vdac_diff=+0.8
* u<0 -> D=+1 -> ctrl_b high -> db high -> Csp->vn, Csn->vp => Vdac_diff=-0.8
XD1 xp vp da dabar vss vdd tg
XD2 xp vn db dbbar vss vdd tg
XD3 xn vn da dabar vss vdd tg
XD4 xn vp db dbbar vss vdd tg

* === decision-hold latch: transparent on phi1, gated-feedback hold on phi2 ===
* da captures ctrl_a ; feedback (2 inversions) closes only during phi2
XLA1 ctrl_a da c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XLA2 da dabar vss vdd inv
XLA3 dabar dafb vss vdd inv
XLA4 dafb da c2a c2b vss vdd tg
* db captures ctrl_b
XLB1 ctrl_b db c1a c1b vss vdd tg
XLB2 db dbbar vss vdd inv
XLB3 dbbar dbfb vss vdd inv
XLB4 dbfb db c2a c2b vss vdd tg

.ends sigma_adc

circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC.
* Single differential sampling cap per side sums the input and the 1-bit DAC
* feedback (DAC applied during phi1 when the StrongARM decision is valid, so no
* decision latch is required). Cs=200f, Ci=400f (Cs/Ci=0.5).
.subckt tg d s g gn vdd vss
* Transmission gate: on when g high and gn low (complementary clocks).
XMN d g s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XMP d gn s vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends tg

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* Integrating (Miller feedback) capacitors Ci=400f.
Cip intp inp 400f
Cin intn inn 400f

* ---- Differential sampling caps Cs=200f (input + DAC summed on one cap) ----
* P-side: plate A (sp_a) phi1->vip / phi2->inp ; plate B (sp_b) phi1->vdac_p / phi2->vcm.
Csp sp_a sp_b 200f
Xtg_sp_a1 sp_a vip     c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_sp_a2 sp_a inp     c2a c2b vdd vss tg
Xtg_sp_b1 sp_b vdac_p  c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_sp_b2 sp_b vcm     c2a c2b vdd vss tg
* N-side: plate A (sn_a) phi1->vin / phi2->inn ; plate B (sn_b) phi1->vdac_n / phi2->vcm.
Csn sn_a sn_b 200f
Xtg_sn_a1 sn_a vin     c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_sn_a2 sn_a inn     c2a c2b vdd vss tg
Xtg_sn_b1 sn_b vdac_n  c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_sn_b2 sn_b vcm     c2a c2b vdd vss tg

* ---- 1-bit DAC multiplexer, enabled only during phi1 (c1a gate) ----
* vdac_p = vp when D=+1 (ctrl_b high), vn when D=-1 (ctrl_a high).
Xtg_dpvn_e vdac_p mpvn c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_dpvn_s mpvn   vn   ctrl_a ctrl_b vdd vss tg
Xtg_dpvp_e vdac_p mpvp c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_dpvp_s mpvp   vp   ctrl_b ctrl_a vdd vss tg
* vdac_n = vn when D=+1 (ctrl_b high), vp when D=-1 (ctrl_a high).
Xtg_dnvn_e vdac_n mnvn c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_dnvn_s mnvn   vn   ctrl_b ctrl_a vdd vss tg
Xtg_dnvp_e vdac_n mnvp c1a c1b vdd vss tg
Xtg_dnvp_s mnvp   vp   ctrl_a ctrl_b vdd vss tg
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit switched-capacitor delta-sigma ADC core.
* Single transistor-level OTA + StrongARM are external fixtures.
* Topology: parasitic-insensitive delaying SC integrator.
*   phi1 (c1a/c1b): sample input onto Cs (bottom plate to vcm).
*   phi2 (c2a/c2b): transfer charge to Ci via virtual ground, apply 1-bit DAC
*                   feedback selected by the held decision (dp/dn).
* The StrongARM evaluates during phi1 and is reset during phi2, so a
* clocked D-latch holds the decision through phi2 to drive the DAC.

* Transmission gate: conducts between a-b when nclk high and pclk low.
.subckt tg a b nclk pclk vdd vss
XMN a nclk b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XMP a pclk b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends tg

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* ----- capacitors -----
* Differential sampling capacitors Cs=200fF.
Csp tp bp 200f
Csn tn bn 200f
* Integrating capacitors Ci=400fF -> Cs/Ci = 0.5
Cip inp intp 400f
Cin inn intn 400f

* ----- top-plate sample/transfer switches -----
* Csp top plate: sample vip on phi1, transfer to inp (virtual ground) on phi2.
XTP1 tp vip c1a c1b vdd vss tg
XTP2 tp inp c2a c2b vdd vss tg
* Csn top plate: sample vin on phi1, transfer to inn on phi2.
XTN1 tn vin c1a c1b vdd vss tg
XTN2 tn inn c2a c2b vdd vss tg

* ----- bottom-plate sample/DAC switches -----
* Csp bottom plate: vcm on phi1, DAC reference vdacp on phi2.
XBP1 bp vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tg
XBP2 bp vdacp c2a c2b vdd vss tg
* Csn bottom plate: vcm on phi1, DAC reference vdacn on phi2.
XBN1 bn vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tg
XBN2 bn vdacn c2a c2b vdd vss tg

* ----- 1-bit DAC reference multiplexer -----
* Held decision: dp high  -> D=+1 (ctrl_b high); dn high -> D=-1 (ctrl_a high).
* Polarity (choice B): D=+1 -> vdacp=vn, vdacn=vp ; D=-1 -> vdacp=vp, vdacn=vn.
XRP1 vn vdacp dp dn vdd vss tg
XRP2 vp vdacp dn dp vdd vss tg
XRN1 vp vdacn dp dn vdd vss tg
XRN2 vn vdacn dn dp vdd vss tg

* ----- decision-hold latch (transparent on phi1, holds on phi2) -----
* Sample the StrongARM decision on phi1: ctrl_b -> dp.
XLTG dp ctrl_b c1a c1b vdd vss tg
* Static inverter INV1: dp -> dn (always active, drives the dn-gated DAC paths).
XINVN dn dp vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XINVP dn dp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* Clocked (C2MOS) feedback inverter: dn -> dp, enabled only on phi2.
XFBP1 midp c2b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XFBP2 dp dn midp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
XFBN1 dp dn midn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XFBN2 midn c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Switched-capacitor 1-bit delta-sigma ADC core
* phi1 (c1a/c1b) sample, phi2 (c2a/c2b) integrate; cross-coupled Cf
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* --- 1-bit DAC reference muxes (ctrl gated; both-high state = vn, no short)
XDACPP mp ctrl_a vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40.0 nf=8
XDACPN mp ctrl_a vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XDACNP mn ctrl_b vp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40.0 nf=8
XDACNN mn ctrl_b vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
* --- integrator feedback caps (straight: OTA gain is (intp-intn)=-A*(inp-inn))
CCFP intp inp 300f
CCFN intn inn 300f
* --- summing-node clamp to vcm on phi1 (start-up path, kills gain leak)
XCLPPn inp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XCLPPp inp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XCLNNn inn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XCLNNp inn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
* --- direct path: Cd2 samples (vip-mp) on phi1, dumps into inp on phi2
CD2P xpa xpb 300f
CD2N xna xnb 300f
XID2Pn xpa c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=5
XID2Pp xpa c1b vip vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=5
XID2Nn xna c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=5
XID2Np xna c1b vin vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=10.0 nf=5
XRD2PP xpb c1b mp vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40.0 nf=8
XRD2PN xpb c1a mp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XRD2NP xnb c1b mn vp sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=40.0 nf=8
XRD2NN xnb c1a mn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XFD2PAn xpa c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=5
XFD2PAp xpa c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=5
XFD2NAn xna c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=5
XFD2NAp xna c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=5.0 nf=5
XFD2PBn xpb c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XFD2PBp xpb c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XFD2NBn xnb c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
XFD2NBp xnb c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=15.0 nf=10
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order differential switched-capacitor delta-sigma ADC core.
* Phi1 samples the input and resolves the StrongARM decision.  Phi2
* transfers the sampled charge and the held, opposite-phase DAC charge.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Static NAND set/reset latch.  Both StrongARM outputs high is its hold
* state, so the resolved decision remains valid throughout phi2.
* q_b is the held ctrl_b state and q_a is its complement.
XLBP q_b ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLBN q_b q_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLBD q_b ctrl_a lnb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLBE lnb q_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLAP q_a ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLAN q_a q_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLAD q_a ctrl_b lna vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLAE lna q_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* Differential sampling capacitors and their phi1 input switches.
* The crossed signal polarity matches the OTA/comparator pin mapping.
CSP sp bp 600f
CSN sn bn 600f
XIPN bp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XIPP bp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XINN bn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XINP bn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* Reset the sampling-capacitor top plates to vcm during phi1.
XTRPN sp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XTRPP sp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XTRNN sn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XTRNP sn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* Connect the sampled capacitors to the OTA summing nodes during phi2.
XTTN sp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XTTP sp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XTNN sn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XTNP sn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* For D=+1 the held code applies vn to the inp-side capacitor and vp
* to the inn-side capacitor; this gives the required negative feedback.
XDPPN dacs_p q_a vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDPPP dacs_p q_b vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDPNN dacs_p q_b vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDPNP dacs_p q_a vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDNPN dacs_n q_b vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDNPP dacs_n q_a vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDNNN dacs_n q_a vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDNNP dacs_n q_b vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* Apply the selected references to the bottom plates only during phi2.
XDPHN bp c2a dacs_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDPHP bp c2b dacs_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XDNHN bn c2a dacs_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDNHP bn c2b dacs_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* Trim 300 fF-equivalent differential DAC charge with an oppositely
* phased 120 fF pair.  The 3x state scaling reduces quantizer-offset
* sensitivity; the resulting input/DAC coefficients are 1.5/1.2.
CDP sp bcp 120f
CDN sn bcn 120f
XCRPN bcp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XCRPP bcp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XCRNN bcn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XCRNP bcn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XCDPN bcp c2a dacs_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XCDPP bcp c2b dacs_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XCDNN bcn c2a dacs_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XCDNP bcn c2b dacs_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* Cross-coupled integrating capacitors provide negative capacitive
* feedback around the externally crossed fully differential OTA.
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f
.ends sigma_adc
