taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order fully differential switched-capacitor delta-sigma ADC.
* The NAND decision latch holds the StrongARM result while its outputs reset.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Cross-coupled NAND SR latch.  D=+1 (ctrl_a low) makes da high.
XLA_P1 da ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XLA_P2 da db vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XLA_N1 da ctrl_a la_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15
XLA_N2 la_n db vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15
XLB_P1 db ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XLB_P2 db da vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15
XLB_N1 db ctrl_b lb_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15
XLB_N2 lb_n da vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15

* Held one-bit DAC multiplexers.  dp-dn = -0.8 V for D=+1.
XDP_VN_N dp da vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDP_VN_P dp db vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XDP_VP_N dp db vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDP_VP_P dp da vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XDN_VP_N dn da vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDN_VP_P dn db vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XDN_VN_N dn db vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XDN_VN_P dn da vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* Phi1 input sampling switches (crossed for the inverting integrator).
XSP_IN_N sap c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSP_IN_P sap c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSN_IN_N san c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSN_IN_P san c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSP_CM_N smp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSP_CM_P smp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSN_CM_N smn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSN_CM_P smn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* Phi2 DAC and charge-transfer switches.
XSP_DAC_N sap c2a dp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSP_DAC_P sap c2b dp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSN_DAC_N san c2a dn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSN_DAC_P san c2b dn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSP_INT_N smp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSP_INT_P smp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XSN_INT_N smn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XSN_INT_P smn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* Weak symmetric differential OTA output loading; preserves output common mode.
ROFS_P intp vn 850k
ROFS_N intn vp 850k

* Differential sampling and integrating capacitors.
CSP sap smp 140f
CSN san smn 140f
CIP intp inp 280f
CIN intn inn 280f
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC - switched-capacitor core.
*
* Loop (per sample period, phi1 then phi2), differential quantities
* x = vip-vin, v1 = v1p-v1n (integrator 1 state), u = intp-intn (=quantizer
* input), D = +1 when ctrl_b is high / ctrl_a is low (latch node dq=1):
*
*   phi1 : input caps sample x with their top plate at vcm;
*          C12 and CD1 sample v1 with their top plate at vcm;
*          C2D is reset (both plates at vcm);
*          StrongARM evaluates the held u, NAND SR latch captures the
*          decision (held through phi2 and the reset phase);
*          both integrators hold their state.
*   phi2 : every top plate joins its virtual ground; the bottom plates move
*          (input cap -> DAC level selected by the held decision, CD1 -> vcm,
*          C12 -> vcm, C2D -> DAC level) and the charge transfers.
*
* Resulting difference equations (Ci1 = integrator-1 feedback cap, etc.):
*   v1[k] = (1-CD1/Ci1) v1[k-1] + (CX1/Ci1) (x[k] - 0.8 D[k])
*   u [k] =      u [k-1] + (C12/Ci2) v1[k-1] - (C2D/Ci2) 0.8 D[k]
* i.e. in normalized units a_x = +CX1/Ci1, a_D = -CX1/Ci1, b_1 = C12/Ci2,
* b_D = -C2D/Ci2, rho_1 = 1-CD1/Ci1.  With a_x = -a_D the STF is flat; the
* single remaining shape parameter is r = |b_D|/(b_1 |a_D|) = C2D*Ci1/(C12*CX1).
* Cap ratios below give r = 2.69, |a_x| = 0.35, b_1 = 0.775, so the expected
* state swings are v1 ~ 0.78 V and u ~ 0.85 V differential peak.
*
* Polarity (per the derivation, P side = the cap whose top lands on `inp`,
* loop variables are the N-minus-P differentials u = intn-intp, v1 = v1n-v1p):
*   the P-side input cap samples vin (cross coupled) and its bottom plate is
*   driven to vn for D=+1, so d(u) contains +(C/Ci)(x - 0.8*D); C12 samples
*   its own stage directly (P bottom to v1p) so its contribution is +b_1*v1;
*   the damping cap is cross coupled (P bottom to v1n) so it subtracts.

* ---------------------------------------------------------------- interfaces
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ------------------------------------------------- integrator-1 capacitors
* Feedback around the internal first-integrator OTA.
C1FP v1p i1p 2p
C1FN v1n i1n 2p
* Input + DAC sampling (one cap does both jobs, exactly like the proven
* first-order core: sample x on phi1, apply the DAC level on phi2).
CX1P bx1p tx1p 700f
CX1N bx1n tx1n 700f
* Damping (leak) cap: samples v1 on phi1, discharges into the summing node on
* phi2 -> exact per-cycle factor (1 - CD1/Ci1) on the integrator-1 state.
CD1P bd1p td1p 40f
CD1N bd1n td1n 40f
* DC path for the integrator-1 summing nodes (charge only, 10meg is inert).
RB1P i1p vcm 10meg
RB1N i1n vcm 10meg

* ------------------------------------------------- integrator-2 capacitors
* Feedback caps around the external OTA (OTA is inverting inp->intp).
CFP intp inp 2p
CFN intn inn 2p
* v1 sampling into integrator 2 (cross coupled: P side samples v1n).
C12P b12p t12p 1.55p
C12N b12n t12n 1.55p
* Integrator-2 DAC caps: reset to vcm on phi1, driven to the DAC level on phi2.
C2DP b2p t2p 1.46p
C2DN b2n t2n 1.46p

* ------------------------------------------------- top-plate switching
* phi1: top plates rest at vcm.  phi2: top plates join their virtual ground.
XTX1P  tx1p vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTX1P2 tx1p i1p c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTX1N  tx1n vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTX1N2 tx1n i1n c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTD1P  td1p vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTD1P2 td1p i1p c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTD1N  td1n vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XTD1N2 td1n i1n c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT12P  t12p vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT12P2 t12p inp c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT12N  t12n vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT12N2 t12n inn c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT2P  t2p vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT2P2 t2p inp c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT2N  t2n vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XT2N2 t2n inn c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw

* ------------------------------------------------- integrator-1 bottom plates
* Input sampling on phi1 (cross coupled), DAC level on phi2.
XBX1P_IN bx1p vin c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XBX1N_IN bx1n vip c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XBX1P_VN bx1p vn da dab vss vdd sc_tgw
XBX1P_VP bx1p vp db dbb vss vdd sc_tgw
XBX1N_VP bx1n vp da dab vss vdd sc_tgw
XBX1N_VN bx1n vn db dbb vss vdd sc_tgw
* Damping: sample v1 on phi1 (cross coupled), vcm on phi2 -> the exact
* per-cycle factor (1 - CD1/Ci1) on the integrator-1 state.
XBD1P  bd1p v1n c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XBD1P2 bd1p vcm c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XBD1N  bd1n v1p c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XBD1N2 bd1n vcm c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw

* ------------------------------------------------- integrator-2 bottom plates
* C12: sample v1 on phi1 (direct), vcm on phi2 -> +b1*v1 into integrator 2.
XB12P  b12p v1p c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XB12P2 b12p vcm c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
XB12N  b12n v1n c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XB12N2 b12n vcm c2a c2b vss vdd sc_tgw
* C2D: vcm reset on phi1, DAC level on phi2.
XB2P    b2p vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XB2P_VN b2p vn da dab vss vdd sc_tgw
XB2P_VP b2p vp db dbb vss vdd sc_tgw
XB2N    b2n vcm c1a c1b vss vdd sc_tgw
XB2N_VP b2n vp da dab vss vdd sc_tgw
XB2N_VN b2n vn db dbb vss vdd sc_tgw

* ------------------------------------------------- first integrator OTA
XOTA1 vss vdd vcm i1p i1n v1p v1n ota1

* ------------------------------------------------- decision-hold SR latch
* Cross-coupled NAND: inputs are the StrongARM outputs directly.  The
* StrongARM reset state (both high) is the latch hold state.
XNAND_Q dq dqn ctrl_a vss vdd sc_nand2
XNAND_QN dqn dq ctrl_b vss vdd sc_nand2

* ------------------------------------------------- DAC enable decode
* da = c2a . dq      db = c2a . dqn
XNAND_A dab c2a dq vss vdd sc_nand2
XINV_A  da dab vss vdd sc_inv
XNAND_B dbb c2a dqn vss vdd sc_nand2
XINV_B  db dbb vss vdd sc_inv

.ends sigma_adc

* ------------------------------------------------------------------ helpers
* CMOS transmission gate: passes a<->b while en is high.
.subckt sc_tg a b en enb vss vdd
XTGN a en b  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XTGP a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
.ends sc_tg

* Wide transmission gate for the pF-scale switching of the second-order core.
.subckt sc_tgw a b en enb vss vdd
XTGN a en b  vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=2
XTGP a enb b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4.0 nf=2
.ends sc_tgw

* CMOS NAND: out = !(i1 . i2)
.subckt sc_nand2 out i1 i2 vss vdd
XN1 out i1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN2 out i2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.0 nf=1
XN3 out i1 nx vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XN4 nx  i2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
.ends sc_nand2

* CMOS inverter
.subckt sc_inv out in vss vdd
XIP out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.0 nf=1
XIN out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends sc_inv

* ----------------------------------------------------------- first OTA
* Five-transistor fully differential OTA with transistor CMFB, same topology
* as the external fixture OTA but self biased from vdd through an ideal
* resistor (there is no iref pin on sigma_adc).  Port note: input `ip` is
* inverting with respect to output `op` (its branch drains into op).
.subckt ota1 vss vdd vcm ip in op on
* Reference branch: ideal resistor fixes the current (deterministic in sim).
RB vdd nb 140k
XREF nb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=8 nf=1
* Tail mirror, (W/L)=80 vs reference (W/L)=4  ->  ~20x.
XTAIL ntail nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
* Input pair: ip drains to op, in drains to on.
XINP op ip ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
XINN on in ntail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=80 nf=8
* PMOS loads, gates driven by the CMFB.
XLP op vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
XLN on vbp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=200 nf=20
* CMFB: resistive/capacitive averaging of the two outputs, sense pair
* against vcm, mirrored onto the PMOS load gates (vbp).
RAP op vsns 1meg
RAN on vsns 1meg
CAP op vsns 400f
CAN on vsns 400f
XCT cmt nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2.0 w=8 nf=1
XCS cmm vsns cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=20 nf=2
XCR vbp vcm cmt vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=20 nf=2
XCLE cmm cmm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=12 nf=2
XCLR vbp cmm vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=12 nf=2
.ends ota1

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC - switched-capacitor core (v2).
* Split sampling capacitors per side:
*   Cx (input):  bottom plate samples the CROSSED input during phi1 while
*                its top plate sits at vcm; in phi2 the bottom plate goes to
*                vcm and the top plate dumps onto the OTA summing node.
*   Cf (feedback/DAC): bottom plate tied to vcm; top plate samples the DAC
*                level selected by the latched 1-bit decision during phi1 and
*                dumps onto the summing node in phi2.
* Loop map: V_O[n] = rho*V_O[n-1] - gx*x[n] + 0.8*gf*code[n];
* alpha = gx/gf = Cx/Cf is the real tone-structure knob; large Ci keeps the
* finite-gain leakage (1-rho) = (Cx+Cf)/(A*Ci) small.
* The StrongARM decision is latched (SR) and steers the DAC switches.
* Polarity: the loop drives mean(code) = Vin_diff/0.8 V.

.subckt swx a b gn gp vss vdd
* MOS wrapper terminal order is drain, gate, source, bulk.
XMN a gn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XMP a gp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3 nf=2
.ends swx

.subckt swxs a b gn gp vss vdd
* Small transmission gate for the DAC paths (low junction cap on the
* feedback-cap top plate).
XMN a gn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XMP a gp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.63 nf=1
.ends swxs

.subckt nand2 y i1 i2 vss vdd
XN1 y i1 m vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XN2 m i2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XP1 y i1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP2 y i2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
.ends nand2

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* Integrating capacitors.
CCI_P inp intp 2.7p
CCI_N inn intn 2.7p
* Input sampling caps (bottom-plate sampling, crossed inputs).
CCX_P bxp sxp 252f
CCX_N bxn sxn 252f
* Feedback caps; bottom plates fixed at vcm.
CCF_P vcm sfp 210f
CCF_N vcm sfn 210f
* phi1: bottom plates sample the differential input (crossed for loop sign).
XSW_IP vin bxp c1a c1b vss vdd swx
XSW_IN vip bxn c1a c1b vss vdd swx
* phi2: bottom plates to common mode.
XSW_BP vcm bxp c2a c2b vss vdd swx
XSW_BN vcm bxn c2a c2b vss vdd swx
* Cx top plates: vcm during phi1, summing nodes during phi2.
XSW_XV_P vcm sxp c1a c1b vss vdd swx
XSW_XV_N vcm sxn c1a c1b vss vdd swx
XSW_XI_P sxp inp c2a c2b vss vdd swx
XSW_XI_N sxn inn c2a c2b vss vdd swx
* Cf top plates to the summing nodes during phi2.
XSW_FI_P sfp inp c2a c2b vss vdd swx
XSW_FI_N sfn inn c2a c2b vss vdd swx
* Summing-node DC paths for startup (parallel to the bench 5meg).
RXI_P inp vcm 470k
RXI_N inn vcm 470k
* Decision-hold SR latch. da=1 for code -1, db=1 for code +1;
* the latch holds its state while the StrongARM resets (both ctrl high).
XND1 da ctrl_b db vss vdd nand2
XND2 db ctrl_a da vss vdd nand2
* DAC switch network: series combination of decision TG and phi1 TG,
* driving the Cf top plates.
* da=1 (code -1): sfp<-vp, sfn<-vn (+0.8 V differential on Cf).
XDAC_PV vp dpp da db vss vdd swxs
XDAC_PP dpp sfp c1a c1b vss vdd swxs
XDAC_NV vn dnn da db vss vdd swxs
XDAC_NN dnn sfn c1a c1b vss vdd swxs
* db=1 (code +1): sfp<-vn, sfn<-vp (-0.8 V differential on Cf).
XDAC_PN vn dpn db da vss vdd swxs
XDAC_PQ dpn sfp c1a c1b vss vdd swxs
XDAC_NP vp dnp db da vss vdd swxs
XDAC_NQ dnp sfn c1a c1b vss vdd swxs
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC: switched-capacitor core.
* Differential SC integrator (Cs=200f sampling, Ci=400f integrating),
* MOS 1-bit DAC (crossed vp/vn feedback), and decision-hold network that
* captures the StrongARM decision during phi1 and steers the DAC in phi2.
*
* Topology and timing notes:
*  - phi1 (c1a): Cs bottom plates sample the (crossed) inputs while the Cs
*    top plates are clamped to vcm, so the sampled charge is Cs*(vcm - v_s)
*    per side and the OTA summing nodes are left undisturbed (Ci holds the
*    previous state for the StrongARM decision). StrongARM is latched and
*    its decision is sampled onto na/nb. The StrongARM reset edge coincides
*    with the c1a falling edge, so the sampler gate is regenerated from c1b
*    through an inverter to cut off early.
*  - phi2 (c2a): Cs top plates connect to the summing nodes and bottom
*    plates to vp/vn per the held decision; charge Cs*(v_s - Vdac) is
*    pushed into the integrating caps in one shot.
*  - Loop polarity: D=+1 (ctrl_b high) means intp<intn. With inputs crossed
*    (Cs_p samples vin) and the DAC crossed (D=+1 -> Cs_p bottom to vn,
*    Cs_n bottom to vp) the loop is negative feedback and the mean code
*    equals +(vip-vin)_dc/0.8.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* --- sampling/integrating capacitors ---
* Cs top plates clamp to vcm in phi1 (sampling) and connect to the OTA
* summing nodes only in phi2, so the sampled charge Cs*(vcm - vin_s) is
* delivered to Ci in one shot during phi2 without input cancellation.
CSP ctp cbp 300f
CSN ctn cbn 300f
CIP inp intp 400f
CIN inn intn 400f

* --- Cs top-plate switches ---
* ctp/ctn to summing nodes during phi2; to vcm during phi1.
* Inputs are crossed (Cs_p samples vin, Cs_n samples vip) to get the right
* loop polarity and code sign.
XSTPP inp c2b ctp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3   nf=1
XSTPN ctp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2   nf=1
XSTNP inn c2b ctn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=3   nf=1
XSTNN ctn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2   nf=1
XSVCP ctp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XSVPP ctp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XSVCN ctn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XSVNP ctn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

* --- clock regeneration for sampler gates (fast early cutoff) ---
* gs follows c1a, gsb follows c1b, sharpened by an inverter pair.
XIBN gs  c1b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1    nf=1
XIBP gs  c1b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2    nf=1
XI2N gsb gs  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1    nf=1
XI2P gsb gs  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2    nf=1

* --- delayed sampling clock for the input switches (samplers keep fast gs/gsb) ---
RGD1 gs  gs1 500
CGD1 gs1 vss 68f
RGD2 gsb gsb1 500
CGD2 gsb1 vss 68f
* --- input sampling switches (phi1), bottom-plate sampling, crossed ---
XS1PN cbp gs1 vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XS1PP cbp gsb1 vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XS1NN cbn gs1 vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XS1NP cbn gsb1 vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1

* --- decision-hold: sample ctrl_a/ctrl_b during phi1, keep through phi2 ---
* Transmission-gate samplers gated by gs/gsb, hold caps, weak cross-coupled
* keeper to restore clean logic levels after the sampler cuts off.
XTAN na gs ctrl_a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XTAP na gsb ctrl_a vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XTBN nb gs ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XTBP nb gsb ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
CHA na vss 150f
CHB nb vss 150f
XKAN nb na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XKAP nb na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XKBN na nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XKBP na nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1

* --- phi2 gating of the held decision: phi_p = c2a AND nb, phi_n = c2a AND na ---
* phi_p selects the D=+1 DAC paths, phi_n the D=-1 paths.
* phib_p/phib_n are the NAND outputs (complements).
XNBN phib_p c2a midb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XNBM midb  nb   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XNBP1 phib_p c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2   nf=1
XNBP2 phib_p nb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2   nf=1
XIPN phi_p phib_p vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1  nf=1
XIPP phi_p phib_p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2  nf=1
XNAN phib_n c2a mida vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XNAM mida  na   vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XNAP1 phib_n c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2   nf=1
XNAP2 phib_n na  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2   nf=1
XIPN2 phi_n phib_n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIPP2 phi_n phib_n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* --- 1-bit DAC switches (phi2), crossed for loop polarity ---
* D=+1 (phi_p): cbp <- vn, cbn <- vp.   D=-1 (phi_n): cbp <- vp, cbn <- vn.
XSDPN cbp phi_p  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XSDPP cbp phib_p vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XSNPN cbn phi_p  vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XSNPP cbn phib_p vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XSDPN2 cbp phi_n  vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XSDPP2 cbp phib_n vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
XSNPN2 cbn phi_n  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1   nf=1
XSNPP2 cbn phib_n vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.5 nf=1
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit switched-capacitor delta-sigma ADC core.
* Two non-overlapping phases; the StrongARM decision is held for phi2.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* Local bias and a scaled fully differential OTA for the first integrator.
RBIAS1 vdd iref1 47k
XREF1 iref1 iref1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=4 nf=1
XTAIL1 tail1 iref1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=24 nf=6
XINP1 o1p i1p tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=150 nf=6
XINN1 o1n i1n tail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=150 nf=6
XLOADP1 o1p cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=80 nf=8
XLOADN1 o1n cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=80 nf=8
RAVGP1 o1p vsense1 1meg
RAVGN1 o1n vsense1 1meg
CAVGP1 o1p vsense1 100f
CAVGN1 o1n vsense1 100f
CLP1 o1p vss 200f
CLN1 o1n vss 200f
XCMTAIL1 cmtail1 iref1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=1.2 nf=1
XCMSENSE1 cmmirror1 vsense1 cmtail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=6 nf=1
XCMREF1 cmfb1 vcm cmtail1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=6 nf=1
XCMLOAD1 cmmirror1 cmmirror1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=3.6 nf=1
XCMLOADR1 cmfb1 cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=3.6 nf=1
RBIP1 i1p vcm 5meg
RBIN1 i1n vcm 5meg

* First integrator: crossed input sampling gives v1=o1n-o1p.
XF1APN fap c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1APP fap c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XF1BPN fbp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1BPP fbp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XF1ANN fan c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1ANP fan c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XF1BNN fbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1BNP fbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
CS1P fap fbp 120f
CS1N fan fbn 120f
XF1TPN fbp c2a i1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1TPP fbp c2b i1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XF1TNN fbn c2a i1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1TNP fbn c2b i1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XF1DPN fap c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1DPP fap c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XF1DNN fan c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XF1DNP fan c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
CI1P i1p o1p 400f
CI1N i1n o1n 400f

* Second integrator signal path, sampling the preceding integrator in phi1.
XS2APN sap c1a o1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2APP sap c1b o1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS2BPN sbp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2BPP sbp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS2ANN san c1a o1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2ANP san c1b o1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS2BNN sbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2BNP sbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
CS2P sap sbp 114f
CS2N san sbn 114f
XS2TPN sbp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2TPP sbp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS2TNN sbn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2TNP sbn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS2RPN sap c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2RPP sap c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XS2RNN san c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XS2RNP san c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2

* Independent second-stage DAC path sets a weaker feedback coefficient.
XD2APN dap c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2APP dap c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XD2BPN dbp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2BPP dbp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XD2ANN dan c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2ANP dan c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XD2BNN dbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2BNP dbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
CD2P dap dbp 97f
CD2N dan dbn 97f
XD2TPN dbp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2TPP dbp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XD2TNN dbn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2TNP dbn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XD2RPN dap c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2RPP dap c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XD2RNN dan c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XD2RNP dan c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
CI2P inp intp 400f
CI2N inn intn 400f

* Weak differential negative conductance raises OTA gain without latching.
XBOOST1P o1p o1n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XBOOST1N o1n o1p vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XBOOST2P intp intn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1
XBOOST2N intn intp vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=1 nf=1

* Complementary one-bit DAC selection; qa=1 is the positive output code.
XDPPVN dacp qb vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XDPPVP dacp qa vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2
XDPNVN dacp qa vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XDPNVP dacp qb vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit delta-sigma switched-capacitor core (Sky130 MOS switches).
* The testbench provides one OTA (intp/intn outputs, inn/inp inputs) and a
* StrongARM that only evaluates during phi1 and compares intn vs intp, so the
* loop is a delayed second-order MOD2 with a PASSIVE first integrator (w_p/w_n)
* and the ACTIVE integrator second:
*   phi1: Cs samples (vip/vin) against the 1-bit DAC level (decision held);
*         Cr samples (w_p/w_n) against the same DAC level.
*   phi2: Cs dumps into the opposite passive node (cross-coupled):
*           W[n] = (1-lam)*(W[n-1] + (Cs/Cw)*(x[n] - D[n]))
*         Cr dumps into the OTA summing inputs:
*           Y[n] = rho*Y[n-1] + (Cr/Ci)*(W[n-1] - D[n]),  Y = intn - intp
*         D[n] = sign(Y[n-1])  (StrongARM during phi1 of cycle n).
* Both NTF zeros sit at (near) DC -> second-order shaping of the quantization
* error; lam = Cr/(Cw+Cr) is the passive-integrator leak.
* Ci dominates the OTA input capacitance; switches sized for full settling
* inside phi2. The decision path buffers the StrongARM outputs (gate-cap load
* only) and holds D through phi2 in a cross-coupled latch pair.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------- decision buffer + hold ----------
* qan=1.8 means D=+1, qbn=1.8 means D=-1.
XPA na ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNA na ctrl_a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPB nb ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNB nb ctrl_b vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNTA na c1a qan vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTA na c1b qan vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNTB nb c1a qbn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTB nb c1b qbn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XH1P qbn qan vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XH1N qbn qan vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XH2P qan qbn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XH2N qan qbn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
* Bias the power-up metastable point toward D=+1 (qan high).
RB1 qan vdd 10meg

* ---------- active integrator (second stage) ----------
CIP inp intp 2p
CIN inn intn 2p

* ---------- passive first integrator ----------
CW_P wp vcm 62p
CW_N wn vcm 62p
RWP wp vcm 10meg
RWN wn vcm 10meg

* ---------- p-side input branch: samples (vip - vdac_p), dumps to wn ----------
CSP bp_p tp_p 15p
XN1 bp_p c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP1 bp_p c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN2 bp_p c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP2 bp_p c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN3 tp_p c1a vdac_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP3 tp_p c1b vdac_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN4 tp_p c2a wn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP4 tp_p c2b wn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* ---------- n-side input branch: samples (vin - vdac_n), dumps to wp ----------
CSN bp_n tp_n 15p
XN7 bp_n c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP7 bp_n c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN8 bp_n c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP8 bp_n c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN9 tp_n c1a vdac_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP9 tp_n c1b vdac_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2
XN10 tp_n c2a wp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XP10 tp_n c2b wp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=2

* ---------- p-side readout branch: samples (wp - vdac_p), dumps to inn ----------
CRP br_p tr_p 1p
XN11 br_p c1a wp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP11 br_p c1b wp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN12 br_p c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP12 br_p c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN13 tr_p c1a vdac_p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP13 tr_p c1b vdac_p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN14 tr_p c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP14 tr_p c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- n-side readout branch: samples (wn - vdac_n), dumps to inp ----------
CRN br_n tr_n 1p
XN15 br_n c1a wn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP15 br_n c1b wn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN16 br_n c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP16 br_n c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN17 tr_n c1a vdac_n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP17 tr_n c1b vdac_n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XN18 tr_n c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XP18 tr_n c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- 1-bit DAC ----------
* vdac_p = vp when D=+1 (qan high), vn when D=-1 (qbn high)
XN20 vdac_p qan vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4
XP20 vdac_p qbn vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=4
XN21 vdac_p qbn vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4
XP21 vdac_p qan vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=4
* vdac_n = vn when D=+1 (qan high), vp when D=-1 (qbn high)
XN22 vdac_n qan vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4
XP22 vdac_n qbn vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=4
XN23 vdac_n qbn vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=4
XP23 vdac_n qan vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=4

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Differential SC integrator (Cs=200f, Ci=400f), MOS 1-bit DAC, decision hold latch.
* Branch "n" (samples vip, DAC vp when D=+1) drives OTA input inn  -> Ci2 to intn.
* Branch "p" (samples vin, DAC vn when D=+1) drives OTA input inp  -> Ci1 to intp.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------------- decision hold latch: q=1 <=> D=+1 ----------------
* cross-coupled NAND: both ctrl high (StrongARM reset, phi2) => hold
XQ1P  q   ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XQ1N1 q   ctrl_a mq1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ1N2 mq1 qb     vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ2P  qb  ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XQ2N1 qb  ctrl_b mq2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XQ2N2 mq2 q      vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1

* ---------------- DAC drive gating: s=AND(q,phi2), t=AND(qb,phi2) ----------------
* s high in phi2 when D=+1 ; t high in phi2 when D=-1 ; n1=~s, n2=~t
XN1P  n1  q  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XN1PA n1  c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XN1N1 n1  q  mn1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XN1N2 mn1 c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XSP   s  n1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XSN   s  n1 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XN2P  n2  qb  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XN2PA n2  c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XN2N1 n2  qb  mn2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XN2N2 mn2 c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XTP   t  n2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1   l=0.15 nf=1
XTN   t  n2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.5 l=0.15 nf=1

* ---------------- integrating capacitors (non-crossed) ----------------
CIN1 inp intp 400f
CIN2 inn intn 400f

* ---------------- branch n : samples vip, drives inn ----------------
* input sample switch (phi1)
XSNI1 L2 c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSPI1 L2 c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* DAC switches (phi2, gated by decision)
XSDP1 L2 s  vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDP2 L2 n1 vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDN1 L2 t  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDN2 L2 n2 vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* reference / transfer switch on summing-node plate
XSRV1 R2 c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSRV2 R2 c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XSRT1 R2 c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSRT2 R2 c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* sampling capacitor
CS2 L2 R2 200f

* ---------------- branch p : samples vin, drives inp ----------------
* input sample switch (phi1)
XSNI3 L1 c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSPI3 L1 c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* DAC switches (phi2, gated by decision)
XSDN3 L1 s  vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDN4 L1 n1 vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDP3 L1 t  vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSDP4 L1 n2 vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* reference / transfer switch on summing-node plate
XSRV3 R1 c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSRV4 R1 c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XSRT3 R1 c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSRT4 R1 c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* sampling capacitor
CS1 L1 R1 200f

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Interface: vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
*
* Per side: Cs samples (vin - vcm) on phi1 and dumps charge into the Ci
* integrator around the fixed OTA on phi2, with the DAC level (vp/vn)
* substituted for vcm on the bottom plate during phi2.  The comparator
* decision is captured during phi1 by a cross-coupled hold latch so the
* 1-bit DAC stays steered while the StrongARM is in reset (phi2).

.subckt tg a b cn cp vdd vss
* transmission gate: on when cn high and cp low
XTG_N a cn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
XTG_P a cp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=6 nf=2
.ends tg

.subckt tgw a b cn cp vdd vss
* weak transmission gate for latch write
XTG_N a cn b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XTG_P a cp b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
.ends tgw

.subckt inv in out vdd vss
XIN_P out in vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=1 nf=1
XIN_N out in vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.5 nf=1
.ends inv

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------------- decision hold latch (holds through phi2) ----------------
XHLP hb ha vdd vss inv
XHLN ha hb vdd vss inv
XWRA ha ctrl_a c1a c1b vdd vss tgw
XWRB hb ctrl_b c1a c1b vdd vss tgw

* ---------------- p-side sampling / integrating network ----------------
* Cs top plate: vip on phi1, virtual ground on phi2
XSP1 tp vip c1a c1b vdd vss tg
XSP2 tp inp c2a c2b vdd vss tg
* Cs bottom plate: vcm on phi1, DAC level on phi2
XBP1 bp vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tg
* D=+1 (ctrl_b high) -> bp to vn
XDNP1 bp xnp hb ha vdd vss tg
XDNP2 xnp vn c2a c2b vdd vss tg
* D=-1 (ctrl_a high) -> bp to vp
XDPP1 bp xpp ha hb vdd vss tg
XDPP2 xpp vp c2a c2b vdd vss tg
CSP tp bp 200f
CIP inp intp 400f

* ---------------- n-side sampling / integrating network ----------------
XSN1 tn vin c1a c1b vdd vss tg
XSN2 tn inn c2a c2b vdd vss tg
XBN1 bn vcm c1a c1b vdd vss tg
* D=+1 (ctrl_b high) -> bn to vp
XDNN1 bn xnn hb ha vdd vss tg
XDNN2 xnn vp c2a c2b vdd vss tg
* D=-1 (ctrl_a high) -> bn to vn
XDPN1 bn xpn ha hb vdd vss tg
XDPN2 xpn vn c2a c2b vdd vss tg
CSN tn bn 200f
CIN inn intn 400f

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR

Cs2p t2p s2p 200f

Xbs2p1p s2p c1b vdp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.15 nf=2

Cs2n t2n s2n 200f
Xas2n1n t2n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=2
Xas2n1p t2n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=12 l=0.15 nf=2
Xas2n2n t2n c2a pn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=6 l=0.15 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit sigma-delta ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Differential sampling/integrating caps, MOS switches, 1-bit DAC, decision latch.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* ---- Sampling and integrating capacitors ----
* Cs usually 200f, Ci 400f -> Cs/Ci = 0.5.
* Top plate of CsP switches between input (phi1) and DAC (phi2).
* Bottom plate of CsP switches between vcm (phi1) and OTA input inp (phi2).
Csp ndac_p bp_p 200f
Csn ndac_n bp_n 200f
Cip inp intp 400f
Cin inn intn 400f

* ---- Input sampling switches (phi1) ----
* Crossed sampling: CsP samples vin, CsN samples vip so the loop polarity is right.
* Transmission gates to reduce signal-dependent charge injection.
XSPIN_N ndac_p c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSPIN_P ndac_p c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XSNIN_N ndac_n c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1 l=0.15 nf=1
XSNIN_P ndac_n c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

* ---- Bottom plate switches ----
* phi1: bottom plate to vcm (analog ground) so OTA holds during compare.
XBPVP bp_p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBPVN bp_n c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
* phi2: bottom plate to OTA virtual ground.
XBPVI bp_p c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1
XBPNI bp_n c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15 nf=1

* ---- 1-bit MOS DAC switches (phi2) ----
* CsP top to vn when lb high (D=+1), to vp when lb low (D=-1).
XDACP_N ndac_p lb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XDACP_P ndac_p lb vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1
* CsN top to vn when la high, to vp when la low.
XDACN_N ndac_n la vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5 l=0.15 nf=1
XDACN_P ndac_n la vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3 l=0.15 nf=1

* ---- Decision-hold SR latch (self-timed) ----
* Holds the comparator decision through phi2. During phi2 the comparator is
* reset (both outputs high) -> the SR gate holds. During phi1 the comparator
* resolves to one low output -> the SR gate updates. Gate loads only (no DC
* path onto the comparator outputs).
* la = NAND(ctrl_b, lb) ; lb = NAND(ctrl_a, la)
XSR1_PD_A la ctrl_b mid_1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.8 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR1_PD_B mid_1 lb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.8 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR1_PU_A la ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR1_PU_B la lb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR2_PD_A lb ctrl_a mid_2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.8 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR2_PD_B mid_2 la vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=0.8 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR2_PU_A lb ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=0.15 nf=1
XSR2_PU_B lb la vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=1.6 l=0.15 nf=1
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC - SC core
* Top-plate-switched sampling caps (crossed) + MOS 1-bit DAC + decision-hold latch.
* MOS pin order: drain gate source bulk
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Sampling caps Cs=200f per side with top-plate switching:
*   phi1: top plate -> vcm (sample input onto Cs), bottom -> vip/vin
*   phi2: top plate -> OTA input, bottom -> DAC bus  (dump charge -> integrate)
*   Only the phi2 edge transfers charge onto the integrating caps, so the
*   integrator accumulates instead of toggling back and forth.
* Cs(topP) dumps onto node inn (crossed: P side feeds the negative input),
* Cs(topN) dumps onto node inp.
* Integrating caps Ci=400f, same-side feedback (CI_P intp<->inp, CI_N intn<->inn).
* Loop: u = intp-intn ; u_new = u + 0.5*(x - 0.8*D), D=+1 <=> q=1 <=> code=+1.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
CS_P topP xs_p 200f
CS_N topN xs_n 200f
CI_P intp inp 800f
CI_N intn inn 800f
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* + input side bottom plate xs_p : phi1->vip, phi2->dacp (DAC bus p)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XS1PN xs_p c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XS1PP xs_p c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XS2PN xs_p c2a dacp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XS2PP xs_p c2b dacp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* - input side bottom plate xs_n : phi1->vin, phi2->dacn (DAC bus n)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XN1PN xs_n c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN1PP xs_n c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XN2PN xs_n c2a dacn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XN2PP xs_n c2b dacn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-plate switches: phi1 -> vcm (sample), phi2 -> crossed OTA input
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XT1P topP c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XT2P topP c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XT1N topN c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XT2N topN c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* DAC bus p : dacp = vp when Q=1 (D=+1), vn when Q=0 (D=-1)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XDBVPN dacp q vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDBVPP dacp qbar vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDBSNN dacp qbar vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDBSNP dacp q vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* DAC bus n : dacn = vn when Q=1 (D=+1), vp when Q=0 (D=-1)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XDBVNN dacn q vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDBVNP dacn qbar vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
XDBS1N dacn qbar vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=2
XDBS1P dacn q vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=2
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* MOS decision-hold network: NAND SR latch, Q=1 <=> D=+1 (ctrl_a low)
*   Q = !(ctrl_a & Qbar) ; Qbar = !(ctrl_b & Q)
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XN1PA q ctrl_a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.88 nf=2
XN1PB q qbar vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.88 nf=2
XN1NA q ctrl_a n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.44 nf=2
XN1NB n1 qbar vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.44 nf=2
XN2PA qbar ctrl_b vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.88 nf=2
XN2PB qbar q vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2.88 nf=2
XN2NA qbar ctrl_b n2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.44 nf=2
XN2NB n2 q vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1.44 nf=2
.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit switched-capacitor delta-sigma ADC core
*
* phi1 (c1a high) : SAMPLE.  Cs is switched between the (crossed) input and
*                   vcm, and is electrically disconnected from the summing
*                   node, so the OTA feedback loop through Ci is undisturbed
*                   and the integrator value is genuinely held.  The StrongARM
*                   evaluates during this phase.
* phi2 (c2a high) : INTEGRATE.  Cs's top plate is re-connected to the summing
*                   node and its bottom plate to the latched 1-bit DAC level,
*                   so the sampled charge transfers into Ci and intp/intn
*                   settle to the new integrator value.
*
*   u[n] = u[n-1] - (Cs/Ci)*(vip-vin)|phi1 + (Cs/Ci)*0.8*D[n]
*
* i.e. the stable first-order loop  u[n] = u[n-1] - g*x[n] + g*0.8*D[n] with
* D = +1 when ctrl_b is high, giving a mean code of +Vindc/0.8.
*
* Two points drive the sizing.  The OTA input pair (w=500 l=0.8 nf=25) presents
* ~3.3 pF of gate capacitance at the summing node, so Ci is 4 pF to keep the
* feedback factor near unity and the virtual-ground error small.  And there is
* no reset switch on the summing node: pinning it to vcm would leave the OTA
* with zero differential drive and let it bleed the stored charge during phi1.
* The summing-node common mode is biased instead by a large resistor, which
* settles in a few clock periods while drawing almost no signal current.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------------- decision-hold latch (transparent on phi1) ----------------
* sq follows ctrl_b while phi1 is high; while phi2 is high the two-inverter
* loop through XLT_FA/XLT_FB statically holds the decision for the DAC.
XLT_IA sq c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLT_IB sq c1b ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLT_FA sq c1b q vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLT_FB sq c1a q vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLT_N1 qn sq vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLT_P1 qn sq vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLT_N2 q qn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XLT_P2 q qn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- p side: Ci, Cs, sample / integrate / DAC switches ----------
* sxp is the floating top plate of Cs.  During phi1 it hangs on vip with the
* bottom plate on vcm; during phi2 it hangs on the summing node with the bottom
* plate on the DAC level mp.  Cs never touches the summing node during phi1.
CIP intp inp 4p
CSP sxp sbp 200f
RCP inp vcm 200k
XSA1 sxp c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSA1P sxp c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSA2 sbp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSA2P sbp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSB1 sxp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSB1P sxp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSB2 sbp c2a mp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSB2P sbp c2b mp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSW_DPN mp q vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSW_DPNP mp qn vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSW_DPP mp qn vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSW_DPPP mp q vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1

* ---------------- n side: mirrored network with the DAC levels swapped --------
CIN intn inn 4p
CSN sxn sbn 200f
RCN inn vcm 200k
XSA3 sxn c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSA3P sxn c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSA4 sbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSA4P sbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSB3 sxn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSB3P sxn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSB4 sbn c2a mn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSB4P sbn c2b mn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSW_DNP mn q vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSW_DNPP mn qn vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1
XSW_DNN mn qn vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSW_DNNP mn q vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=8 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit noise-shaping ADC - switched-capacitor core
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Discrete-time loop, per side, bottom-plate sampling:
*   phi1 : sampling cap bottom plate -> input, top plate on the OTA
*          summing node (integrating cap returns the OTA output)
*   phi2 : sampling cap bottom plate -> +/-0.8 V reference picked by
*          the latched comparator decision
*   u[n] = u[n-1] + (Cs/Ci)*(x[n] - 0.8*D[n]),   D[n] = sign(u[n-1])
* The StrongARM resets while phi2 is high, so the decision is held in a
* NAND SR latch driven by the raw comparator outputs; the DAC switches
* are additionally gated by phi2 so the latch may transition during
* phi1 without disturbing the feedback charge.
* All devices are instantiated flat because this ngspice build does not
* resolve a subcircuit referenced from another subcircuit in one file.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ================= decision latch (holds through phi2) =================
* q = NAND(ctrl_a, qbar) ; qbar = NAND(ctrl_b, q) ;  q=1 <=> D=+1
XLQ_NA q    ctrl_a xlq_n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLQ_NB xlq_n1 qbar  vss   vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLQ_PA q    ctrl_a vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLQ_PB q    qbar   vdd   vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLQB_NA qbar ctrl_b xlqb_n1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XLQB_NB xlqb_n1 q  vss    vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit switched-capacitor delta-sigma modulator core.
*
* Differential SC integrator built around the fixed testbench OTA:
*   Cs = 200fF  input sampling capacitor (one per side)
*   Cd = 200fF  1-bit DAC capacitor     (one per side)
*   Ci = 400fF  integrating capacitor   (one per side)
* so the per-cycle update is  D(out) = 0.5*Vin_diff - 0.4*D  in volts,
* i.e. the nominal first-order loop with Cs/Ci = Cd/Ci = 0.5.
*
* phi1 (c1a high): top plates of Cs/Cd rest on vcm, Cs bottom plate samples
*                  vip/vin, DAC bottom plates rest on vcm.
* phi2 (c2a high): top plates switch to the OTA virtual grounds, Cs bottom
*                  plates go to vcm (charge dumped into Ci), DAC bottom
*                  plates go to vp/vn according to the latched decision.
*
* The StrongARM only holds its decision while its clock is high (phi1), so
* the decision is latched here and regenerated through phi2 to drive the
* DAC reference switches.

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---------------- decision latch ----------------
* q tracks ctrl_b while phi1 is high.  During phi2 the phi2 transmission
* gate closes the q -> qa -> qs -> q two-inverter loop, so the decision is
* regenerated rather than merely stored.  The two gates never overlap, so
* neither driver is ever contested.  qa = NOT q and qs = q.
XNQ   q  c1a ctrl_b vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPQ   q  c1b ctrl_b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XIA_P qa q  vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIA_N qa q  vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XIB_P qs qa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XIB_N qs qa vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XKQ_N q  c2a qs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XKQ_P q  c2b qs vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------- DAC phase gating:  g1 = c2a AND qs (=D=+1),  g0 = c2a AND qa ----------
XND1_P gn qs vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XND2_P gn c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XND1_N gn qs mid1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XND2_N mid1 c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XG1_P g1 gn vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XG1_N g1 gn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

XND3_P gn2 qa vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XND4_P gn2 c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XND3_N gn2 qa mid2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XND4_N mid2 c2a vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XG0_P g0 gn2 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XG0_N g0 gn2 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* ---------------- p-side sampling branch (OTA input inp, output intp) --------
CSP xp bp 200f
CDP xp dbp 200f
CIP inp intp 400f
* top plates: vcm during phi1, OTA virtual ground during phi2
XTA_P  xp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTA2_P xp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTB_P  xp c2a inp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTB2_P xp c2b inp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* input sampling is crossed so the loop is negative-feedback:
* p-side cap samples vin, n-side cap samples vip
XSA_P  bp c1a vin vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSA2_P bp c1b vin vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSC_P  bp c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSC2_P bp c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* DAC bottom plate: vcm during phi1; D=+1 -> vn, D=-1 -> vp
XSV1_P dbp g1 vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSV2_P dbp gn vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSV3_P dbp g0 vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSV4_P dbp gn2 vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSV5_P dbp c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSV6_P dbp c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

* ---------------- n-side sampling branch (OTA input inn, output intn) --------
CSN xn bn 200f
CDN xn dbn 200f
CIN inn intn 400f
XTA_N  xn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTA2_N xn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XTB_N  xn c2a inn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XTB2_N xn c2b inn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSA_N  bn c1a vip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSA2_N bn c1b vip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSC_N  bn c2a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSC2_N bn c2b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSV1_N dbn g1 vp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSV2_N dbn gn vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSV3_N dbn g0 vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSV4_N dbn gn2 vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XSV5_N dbn c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XSV6_N dbn c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1

.ends sigma_adc

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* 2nd-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core with LFSR dither
* Stage 1: internal 5T CMFB OTA, Cs1=200f/Ci1=400f -> v1 += 0.5*(x - D)
* Stage 2: fixed testbench OTA, Cs2=200f/Ci2=400f      -> v2 += 0.5*(v1 - D)
* Dither: period-31 XNOR LFSR, +/-40fF*0.4V packets into stage-2 summing nodes
* Decision hold: phi1-transparent latch, phi2-qualified DAC select logic.
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ================= stage 2 (fixed OTA) sampling/integrating network =================
* p-side cap samples o1n (=v1p), dumps into inn; n-side samples o1p into inp
CS2P sp ip 200f
CS2N sn in 200f
CI2P inp intp 400f
CI2N inn intn 400f
* phi1 sampling of v1
XNSP o1n c1a sp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPSP o1n c1b sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNSN o1p c1a sn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPSN o1p c1b sn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* phi1 reference switches
XNIP1 vcm c1a ip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPIP1 vcm c1b ip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNIN1 vcm c1a in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPIN1 vcm c1b in vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* phi2 transfer switches (cross-coupled)
XNIP2 inn c2a ip vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPIP2 inn c2b ip vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNIN2 inp c2a in vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPIN2 inp c2b in vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= stage 1 (internal OTA) sampling/integrating network =================
CS1P s1p q1p 200f
CS1N s1n q1n 200f
CI1P i1p o1p 400f
CI1N i1n o1n 400f
RI1P i1p vcm 5meg
RI1N i1n vcm 5meg
* phi1 sampling of the ADC input
XNS1P vip c1a s1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPS1P vip c1b s1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XNS1N vin c1a s1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPS1N vin c1b s1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
* phi1 reference switches
XNQ1P vcm c1a q1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPQ1P vcm c1b q1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNQ1N vcm c1a q1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPQ1N vcm c1b q1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
* phi2 transfer switches (p-cap into i1n, n-cap into i1p)
XNQ2P i1n c2a q1p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPQ2P i1n c2b q1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNQ2N i1p c2a q1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPQ2N i1p c2b q1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= stage-1 DAC switches =================
XPD1P vp nb s1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XND1P s1p gna vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPD1N vp na s1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XND1N s1n gnb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= stage-2 DAC switches =================
XPD2P vp nb sp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XND2P sp gna vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPD2N vp na sn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=4 nf=1
XND2N sn gnb vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= stage-1 OTA (scaled 5T CMFB, self biased) =================
RBIAS vdd nb0 75k
XBDIO nb0 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=20 nf=2
XTAIL1 t1 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=170 nf=17
XMIN1P o1p i1p t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=160 nf=8
XMIN1N o1n i1n t1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=160 nf=8
XMLD1N o1n cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=85 nf=8
XMLD1P o1p cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=85 nf=8
RAVG1P o1p vsen1 1meg
RAVG1N o1n vsen1 1meg
CAVG1P o1p vsen1 400f
CAVG1N o1n vsen1 400f
XCT1 ct1 nb0 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=10 nf=1
XCS1 cmir1 vsen1 ct1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=8 nf=1
XCR1 cmfb1 vcm ct1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=8 nf=1
XCL1E cmir1 cmir1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=5 nf=1
XCL1R cmfb1 cmfb1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=5 nf=1

* ================= decision-hold latch (transparent during phi1) =================
XNL1 lb la vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPL1 lb la vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNL2 la lb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XPL2 la lb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XNTA ctrl_a c1a la vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTA ctrl_a c1b la vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNTB ctrl_b c1a lb vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPTB ctrl_b c1b lb vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= phi2-qualified DAC select logic =================
XNNB1 nb c2a nbs vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNNB2 nbs lb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPNB1 nb c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPNB2 nb lb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNNA1 na c2a nas vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XNNA2 nas la vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPNA1 na c2a vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XPNA2 na la vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNGNB gnb nb vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPGNB gnb nb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNGNA gna na vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPGNA gna na vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= LFSR dither: 5 DFFs, XNOR(q5,q3) feedback =================
XDFF1 df1 c1a c1b q1 vdd vss mydff
RINIT q1 vss 100k
XDFF2 q1 c1a c1b q2 vdd vss mydff
XDFF3 q2 c1a c1b q3 vdd vss mydff
XDFF4 q3 c1a c1b q4 vdd vss mydff
XDFF5 q4 c1a c1b q5 vdd vss mydff

* XNOR(q5,q3) -> df1 ; complementary CMOS with local input inverters
XXIA q5n q5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XXIAP q5n q5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XXIB q3n q3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.42 nf=1
XXIBP q3n q3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=0.84 nf=1
XXP1 df1 q5 xt1 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XXP2 xt1 q3 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XXP3 df1 q5n xt2 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XXP4 xt2 q3n vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XXN1 df1 q5 xu1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XXN2 xu1 q3n vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XXN3 df1 q5n xu2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XXN4 xu2 q3 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

* dither bit buffers
XDBN qbn q5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XDBP qbn q5 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* ================= dither injection into stage-2 summing nodes =================
* dtp/dtn: vcm during phi1; vp/vn (per q5) during phi2 -> +/-0.4*Cdd packets
XNDT1 vcm c1a dtp vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPDT1 vcm c1b dtp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XNDT2 vcm c1a dtn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XPDT2 vcm c1b dtn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
XND51 nd5 c2a nd5s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
XND52 nd5s q5 vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* Second-order 1-bit switched-capacitor delta-sigma ADC core.
*
* Loop filter (both SC integrators invert their sampled input, so the
* signal and DAC connections are crossed on each stage):
*   v1[n] = v1[n-1] + k1*(x[n] - 0.8*D[n])       k1 = Cs1/Ci1 = 0.52
*   v2[n] = v2[n-1] + k2*(v1[n-1] - b2*0.8*D[n]) k2 = Cs2/Ci2 = 0.575
*   D[n]  = sign(v2[n-1])                        b2 = Csd2/Cs2 = 1.15
* NTF = (1-z^-1)^2 / (1 - 1.337 z^-1 + 0.637 z^-2), STF(dc) = 1.
*
* Stage 1 uses a local 5T fully differential OTA with transistor CMFB
* biased from a local resistor/diode reference. Stage 2 is the fixed
* testbench OTA on inp/inn/intp/intn (it must drive the quantizer).
* The StrongARM decision (valid during phi1) is held by a CMOS NAND
* SR latch so it persists through phi2 while the comparator resets.

* ---- local bias generator: ~25 uA reference ----
.subckt adc_bias vss vdd nbias
RBIAS vdd nbias 47k
XNBIAS nbias nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=24 nf=3
.ends adc_bias

* ---- stage-1 OTA: 5T fully differential with transistor CMFB ----
.subckt adc_ota1 vss nbias vdd vinn vinp vcm voutn voutp
XMAIN_TAIL tail nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=144 nf=18
XMAIN_INP voutn vinp tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=132 nf=11
XMAIN_INN voutp vinn tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=132 nf=11
XMAIN_LOADN voutn vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=72 nf=6
XMAIN_LOADP voutp vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=72 nf=6
RAVG_P voutp vsense 1meg
RAVG_N voutn vsense 1meg
CAVG_P voutp vsense 400f
CAVG_N voutn vsense 400f
XCM_TAIL cm_tail nbias vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=8 nf=1
XCM_SENSE cm_mirror vsense cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=7 nf=1
XCM_REF vcmfb vcm cm_tail vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.6 w=7 nf=1
XCM_LOAD_E cm_mirror cm_mirror vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=4 nf=1
XCM_LOAD_R vcmfb vcmfb vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1.2 w=4 nf=1
.ends adc_ota1

.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn

* ---- bias and stage-1 OTA ----
XBIAS vss vdd nbias adc_bias
XOTA1 vss nbias vdd i1n i1p vcm o1p o1n adc_ota1

* ---- stage-1 capacitors ----
* Signal caps Css1 sample x; separate DAC caps Csd1 (bottoms: vcm on
* phi1, DAC on phi2) share the Css1 top node. Signal gain g=Css1/Csd1=1.1.

CS1N as1n bs1n 229f
CSD1P ad1p bs1p 208f
CSD1N ad1n bs1n 208f
CI1P i1p o1p 400f
CI1N i1n o1n 400f

* ---- stage-1 phi1: sample input (crossed), top plates to vcm ----

XPT1P i1p c2b bs1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

XPT1N i1n c2b bs1n vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

XND1PP d1p hold_x vn vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XPD1PP d1p hold_y vn vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

XPD1PN d1p hold_x vp vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

XPS2P as2p c1b o1p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15
XNS2N as2n c1a o1n vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15

XNC2P bs2p c1a vcm vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XPC2P bs2p c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

XPC2N bs2n c1b vcm vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* ---- stage-2 phi2: top plates to fixture-OTA virtual grounds ----
XNT2P inp c2a bs2p vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.15
XPT2P inp c2b bs2p vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=4 l=0.15

* u = intn-intp; D=+1 <=> ctrl_b high <=> u>0.

* Operation:
*   phi1 (c1a high): sample input onto Cs, latch StrongARM decision (D[n-1]),
*                     integrator output holds u[n-1] for the comparator.
*   phi2 (c2a high): transfer sampled charge + DAC feedback (vp/vn selected by
*                     latched D) into the integrating caps -> u[n].

CIN intn inn 400f
* Decision hold capacitors

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Transmission gate (inlined): NFET gate=gH, PFET gate=gL,
*   passes bidirectionally when gH=1.8 and gL=0. Terminal order: d g s b.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Phi1 switches: sample input (Pp=vip, Pn=vin), reference Q to vcm,
*   latch decision (Hp=ctrl_b, Hn=ctrl_a) during phi1.

taskTitle: Design a First-Order 1-bit Delta-Sigma ADC with 40 dB SNDR
circuit:
* First-order 1-bit delta-sigma ADC - switched-capacitor core
* Sky130 tt, vdd=1.8 V, vcm=0.9 V, fs=10 MHz.
* Differential SC integrator: Cs=200 fF sampling, Ci=400 fF integration.
* MOS sample/transfer switches, MOS 1-bit DAC (vp/vn), decision latch
* sampled late in phi1 and held through phi2 (comparator resets in phi2).
.subckt sigma_adc vss vdd vip vin vp vn vcm ctrl_a ctrl_b c1a c1b c2a c2b intp intn inp inn
* Local nodes: ap/ay = Cs top plates, bp/bn = Cs bottom plates,
* la/lb = buffered latched decision inputs, lba/lbA = latched decision,
* xna/xnb = NAND outputs, ena/enb = phase-gated DAC enables.

* Sampling capacitors Cs = 200 fF, integrating capacitors Ci = 400 fF
* (cross-coupled feedback around the inverting OTA).
Cc1 ap bp 200f
Cc2 ay bn 200f
Ci1 intp inp 400f
Ci2 intn inn 400f
* Bleed resistors keep isolated capacitor plate nodes defined for DC.
Rb1 ap vcm 1g
Rb2 ay vcm 1g
Rb3 bp vcm 1g
Rb4 bn vcm 1g

* Phi1 sampling switches: top plates to vip/vin, bottom plates to vcm.
Xs1p ap vip c1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xs1n ap vip c1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xs2p ay vin c1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xs2n ay vin c1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xs3p bp vcm c1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xs3n bp vcm c1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xs4p bn vcm c1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xs4n bn vcm c1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* Phi2 charge-transfer switches: top plates to OTA virtual-ground inputs.
Xt1p ap inp c2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xt1n ap inp c2b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xt2p ay inn c2a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xt2n ay inn c2b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1

* Decision latch: TG samples ctrl during phi1 onto a floating node A;
* inverter B = inv(A) holds the decision low-Z through phi2. B never
* drives back onto ctrl, so the StrongARM regenerates unopposed.
Xla la ctrl_a c1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xlb la ctrl_a c1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
Xlc lb ctrl_b c1a vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=1 nf=1
Xld lb ctrl_b c1b vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=2 nf=1
